added.title: Data & AI Architect (US)
added.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

AI in engineering is only as good as the data it runs on. As our Data & AI Architect, you make our engineering data governed, owned and revision-controlled – and ready for AI. You design reusable data products and architecture patterns that connect engineering data to applications and AI,work with engineering, IT and tool owners, and make sure that every new AI solution builds on the same trusted foundation instead of starting from scratch.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Define and validate the target data and AI architecture for engineering, built on our central engineering data platform
Design reusable data products and interfaces that multiple AI agents and engineering tools can use, including semantic models, APIs, MCP servers and other governed access patterns
Create and maintain a reusable AI architecture blueprint, including agentic RAG, that enables agents to securely access and reason across trusted engineering information while making AI results traceable, auditable and maintainable
Design patterns for both structured and unstructured engineering information, including documents, specifications and other technical content, ensuring that AI retrieves the correct information, context and revision
Establish data ownership, quality rules and governance together with process owners, IT and cybersecurity, including authoritative sources, lineage, access control and lifecycle management
Work closely with the AI Enablement & Delivery Lead to make sure every prioritized use case is technically scalable

What You Bring

Master’s degree or equivalent in computer science, information systems, engineering or a related field
At least 10 years of experience in data architecture, data engineering or enterprise architecture, including data modelling, integration and governance. Experience with engineering or product data (e.g. PLM, CAD/CAE, ERP) and with revision and configuration control
Hands-on experience with modern cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric and Snowflake, including lakehouse architectures, data pipelines, semantic models and governed data products
Practical experience in architecting AI solutions: LLMs, vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation and APIs, agent/tool integration and MCP, on cloud platforms such as Azure. Strong understanding of semantic data modelling and relationship-based modelling approaches such as ontologies or knowledge graphs, with the judgment to apply the appropriate approach to the use case
Ability to prototype and validate architectures hands-on using technologies such as SQL, Python, APIs and cloud data/AI services. Ability to translate business and engineering needs into robust, maintainable architectures, and to align stakeholders across engineering and IT
Structured, quality-minded and pragmatic; fluent English, German is a plus

Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States without need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization. Siemens Energy employees with current visa sponsorship may be eligible for internal transfers.

About The Team

Our Transformation of Industry
division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities. Candidates want to learn about the divisions they will be joining–the structure, how it works together, and the role it plays in driving Siemens Energy’s mission forward.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Rewards

Career growth and development opportunities
Supportive work culture
Company paid Health and wellness benefits
Paid Time Off and paid holidays
401K savings plan with company match
Family building benefits
Parental leave

added.title: Distinguished AI Engineer
added.description:
Regular travel to our Buffalo, NY (Seneca One) hub is required, with an expectation of working onsite one week per month.

Overview

Responsible for shaping enterprise-wide software engineering, artificial intelligence, agentic architecture, and technology strategy while serving as a subject matter expert and one of the organization’s most senior individual-contributor technology leaders within Consumer Technology. Provides technical leadership across Consumer Lending, Consumer Banking, Business Banking, Digital, and other interconnected capabilities.

Translates business and Retail Banking strategies into secure, resilient, scalable, performant, cost-effective, and reusable technology capabilities. Operates across product, business, data, risk, architecture, cybersecurity, and engineering boundaries to enable consistent customer and colleague experiences across channels and lines of business.

Leads primarily through technical authority, influence, architectural judgment, hands-on engineering expertise, and credibility. Establishes engineering direction, advances artificial intelligence and agentic engineering practices, solves highly complex technology challenges, develops technical talent, and serves as a trusted advisor to Executive leaders across Technology and the business. Maintains active, hands-on involvement in software development, including the creation of AI agents, prototypes, reference implementations, reusable components, and production-quality solutions.

Primary Responsibilities

Provide technical leadership across multiple business domains, platforms, and engineering organizations, establishing long-term engineering and technology strategies aligned with enterprise and Consumer Technology priorities.
Serve as a senior technical advisor to Executive leaders across Technology and the business, including Chief Information Officers, Chief Technology Officer leadership, architecture leaders, engineering executives, product leaders, risk partners, and other senior stakeholders.
Influence significant technology investments, architectural decisions, modernization priorities, and engineering strategies without relying on direct organizational authority.
Identify emerging technology trends and evaluate their applicability, risks, benefits, and potential business value to the organization.
Define and champion target architectures for strategic platforms and capabilities supporting Consumer Lending, Consumer Banking, Business Banking, Digital, and related customer and colleague journeys.
Lead the modernization and simplification of complex legacy technology environments while maintaining the availability, security, performance, and stability of business-critical banking platforms.
Establish architectural patterns and engineering practices that enable scalability, interoperability, resilience, security, accessibility, privacy, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency.
Guide architectural and engineering decisions involving cloud and cloud-native platforms, application programming interfaces, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, data platforms, artificial intelligence, agentic systems, and modern application architectures.
Balance strategic architecture and long-term technology objectives with pragmatic delivery, speed to market, customer needs, operational requirements, and business priorities.
Champion and drive the adoption of Software Development Life Cycle practices across domains and at the senior-leader level to ensure adherence to enterprise standards, industry practices, and regulatory requirements.
Maintain hands-on software engineering involvement by authoring, reviewing, and troubleshooting organized, clean, efficient, secure, and production-quality source code. Apply advanced computer engineering concepts, data structures, algorithms, and engineering patterns to solve complex business and technology problems.
Develop AI agents, prototypes, proofs of concept, reference implementations, reusable libraries, frameworks, evaluation harnesses, automated tests, and production-ready integration components that demonstrate approved AI and agentic engineering patterns.
Raise engineering standards by championing automation, DevSecOps, continuous integration and continuous delivery, observability, platform engineering, automated testing, software quality, reliability engineering, and secure software development practices.
Establish reusable engineering patterns, frameworks, reference implementations, paved-road capabilities, and technical standards that improve developer productivity, accelerate delivery, reduce operational complexity, and promote consistency across engineering teams.
Drive the creation, refinement, adoption, and governance of engineering patterns across the organization. Participate in and lead forums with senior engineers, architects, and technology leaders to advance organizational engineering maturity.
Partner with engineering teams and senior leaders to identify and address systemic technical debt, capability gaps, architectural constraints, and operational risks.
Engage directly in the organization’s highest-risk, most complex, or most technically challenging initiatives and transformation programs.
Lead technical problem-solving across applications, infrastructure, data, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, third-party platforms, and interconnected enterprise services.
Facilitate architectural and engineering decisions when multiple viable technical approaches exist, clearly articulating trade-offs, risks, costs, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
Perform deep technical reviews of critical systems, architectures, production solutions, transformation programs, and engineering implementations.
Provide technical leadership during significant production, resiliency, performance, cybersecurity, data, or operational challenges.
Design and lead cross-domain rollouts of engineering capabilities from requirements gathering through implementation, execution, testing, acceptance, and ongoing operation, ensuring applicable regulatory and risk requirements are met.
Drive technology architecture that connects customer acquisition, onboarding, account opening, lending, servicing, payments, relationship management, customer identity, digital engagement, and colleague-facing capabilities.
Promote shared services, reusable application programming interfaces, event-driven patterns, common data capabilities, and consistent identity, authorization, privacy, and security controls across Consumer Technology.
Partner with business, product, design, and technology leaders to translate customer, banker, colleague, and operational needs into cohesive technology strategies, engineering priorities, and investment roadmaps.
Perform quantitative and qualitative benefit analyses for proposed engineering capabilities, modernization investments, and technology strategies. Drive organizational change in support of approved technology roadmaps.
Define the Consumer Technology AI engineering strategy and reference architecture in alignment with enterprise artificial intelligence, data, cloud, cybersecurity, model risk, privacy, legal, compliance, and responsible AI standards.
Design and champion agentic architecture patterns supporting planning, orchestration, tool use, memory, retrieval-augmented generation, human-in-the-loop decisioning, multi-agent collaboration, and secure integration with banking platforms and enterprise services.
Write, review, and troubleshoot code supporting agent orchestration, model routing, tool and application programming interface integration, retrieval and grounding, memory, workflow state, guardrails, evaluation, telemetry, and secure access to enterprise systems.
Lead the development of reusable agentic components, engineering frameworks, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, and paved-road capabilities that accelerate the safe and effective adoption of artificial intelligence across Consumer Technology.
Establish engineering standards for prompt and context management, retrieval and grounding, model selection and routing, agent identity and authorization, observability, auditability, testing, evaluation, performance, resiliency, and cost management.
Guide engineering teams in developing production-grade AI and agentic solutions that improve customer experiences, colleague productivity, engineering effectiveness, servicing, sales, fraud and risk operations, and operating efficiency.
Ensure AI and agentic solutions incorporate appropriate controls for data protection, explainability, bias assessment, model risk, prompt risk, content safety, regulatory compliance, change management, auditability, and human oversight.
Evaluate emerging AI models, development frameworks, platforms, protocols, model services, software development kits, and engineering techniques. Determine where experimentation, adoption, standardization, additional controls, or avoidance is appropriate.
Partner with product, design, data science, architecture, cybersecurity, legal, risk, compliance, model risk, and operations teams to move high-value AI use cases from experimentation to secure, measurable, and sustainable production outcomes.
Ensure critical systems are designed for high availability, resilience, recoverability, performance, observability, and operational transparency.
Embed security, privacy, accessibility, risk, and regulatory expectations into engineering practices, architecture, software design, and technology decision-making.
Partner with cybersecurity, infrastructure, risk, data, and operations teams to identify and mitigate systemic technology risks. Advocate for engineering investments that reduce operational, cybersecurity, resiliency, and technology risks.
Enable engineering teams to adopt enterprise standards that connect business and technology strategies with program execution and critical organizational objectives.
Apply highly specialized and innovative engineering strategies to solve unique business and technology challenges and capitalize on emerging opportunities.
Mentor Principal Engineers, Lead Engineers, Architects, and other senior technical talent. Develop the organization’s next generation of technical leaders through coaching, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing.
Establish and support technical communities of practice and other mechanisms for sharing engineering knowledge, patterns, lessons learned, and emerging practices.
Promote constructive technical debate, continuous learning, engineering excellence, and data-driven decision-making.
Help define expectations, technical competencies, and career pathways for senior individual-contributor engineering roles.
Communicate complex technical topics clearly and effectively to Executive leaders, business partners, risk stakeholders, engineers, and non-technical audiences.
Build alignment across engineering, architecture, product, cybersecurity, infrastructure, data, risk, operations, and business organizations.
Contribute to technical, organizational, and strategic advancement through enterprise-level expertise, leadership, and influence.
Represent the engineering community in strategic internal discussions, external industry forums, academic events, standards bodies, and peer communities, as appropriate.
Author and publish white papers, technical perspectives, reference architectures, research, and other materials that enhance M&T Bank’s engineering capabilities and contribute to industry dialogue.
Speak at industry conferences, technology forums, academic events, standards bodies, and peer communities on relevant topics, including retail banking technology, AI engineering, agentic architecture, modernization, resilience, and engineering excellence.
Build external relationships with technology leaders, research institutions, strategic partners, and engineering communities to bring relevant practices, research, and insights into M&T Bank.

added.title: Senior Software Engineer - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
added.description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

You will bring deep technical expertise and engineering leadership to some of the most complex and high-impact challenges facing clients across industries.

You will own architectural decisions, set the technical direction for your workstream, and ensure the team delivers scalable, production-ready solutions that create lasting value.

You will work hands-on across the full stack, designing robust systems and making the kind of technical judgments — on architecture, framework selection, cloud design, and the thoughtful application of AI — that shape what your team builds and how they build it. You will mentor both client and internal teams, helping engineers at all levels grow their craft and adopt the engineering practices that make great software possible. Your technical leadership will be felt not just in the code you write, but in the standards you set and the people you develop along the way.

Your work will help solve some of the most complex and high-impact challenges facing clients across industries. Collaborating across McKinsey's QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey and QuantumBlack Labs teams, you'll help develop innovative software capabilities and scalable enterprise solutions. You'll help build robust technical foundations for production-ready, AI-enabled systems. Your contributions will directly support the firm's ability to accelerate AI adoption, solve complex business problems at scale, and enable clients to achieve meaningful, lasting impact.

You'll be based in one of our NA offices as part of our global Software Engineering community. Working in cross-functional teams, you'll collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and industry experts to deliver software solutions. By partnering with clients from technical teams to C-level executives, you'll help solve complex problems that drive tangible business value and continue to grow your skills as a client-facing technologist.

Your work offers a unique opportunity to grow at the forefront of AI and software engineering. You'll develop expertise at the intersection of technology and business by tackling diverse challenges in the evolving AI landscape. Working alongside multidisciplinary teams, you'll gain a holistic understanding of how software engineering enables advanced AI while collaborating with some of the leading technologists and AI experts in the industry.

There is flexibility to hire at different Software / Senior Software Engineer levels, depending on your experience.

Your Qualifications and Skills

Undergraduate or master’s degree; or equivalent experience
5+ years of experience developing full-stack applications, writing code that is readable, testable, maintainable, and scalable
Deep proficiency in at least two frontend or backend frameworks, with the ability to independently evaluate and select packages, define data structures, and deliver robust, scalable solutions across the full stack; hands-on experience with languages and frameworks including JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Angular, Next.js, Vue.js, Java, Spring, C#, or Node.js; SQL and NoSQL databases; cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP); and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, Docker, CircleCI, or similar)
Demonstrated ability to design complex, secure APIs — including REST and GraphQL — with a focus on scalability and maintainability, implementing advanced features such as rate limiting, caching, and API gateways, grounded in expert knowledge of software design patterns including microservices and distributed architectures
Proficiency across two cloud providers with the ability to build complex IaC and CI/CD pipelines from scratch, implement zero downtime deployment strategies, and apply cloud-native architecture concepts to ensure scalability, reliability, and elasticity
Advanced proficiency in AI-assisted engineering, orchestrating specialized agents across parallel workstreams, building reusable agent tooling, and exercising sound technical judgment on AI safety and application boundaries
Experience architecting AI systems and ensuring engineering quality, utilizing robust LLM evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and validation methodologies to deliver reliable, production-grade AI applications
A security-first mindset, able to advocate for standards and compliance, implement authentication flows such as OAuth and OIDC, proactively identify and mitigate security issues during development, and mentor others in secure development practices; ensures quality through comprehensive testing strategies and performance optimization
Experience leading collaborative, cross-functional engineering teams and fostering a strong engineering culture
Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment.
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English and the local office language(s), with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels.

added.title: Machine Learning Engineer
added.description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About The Team

Do you want to build AI-powered software that impacts millions of people every day? The AI Foundations team, part of Workday’s AI Platform organization, tackles challenging problems at the intersection of machine learning, agentic reasoning, and enterprise-scale systems. Our work delivers critical AI platform capabilities and differentiated, deep-value agent applications.

About The Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer on the AI Platform team, you will develop tailored user experiences using advanced Agentic AI, LLMs and RAG. You will collaborate with other engineers to deliver ML solutions across Workday’s product ecosystem and use current software and data engineering stacks to enable training, deployment, and lifecycle management of a variety of ML models; supervised and unsupervised. Additionally, you will develop and deploy new APIs/services using Docker/Kubernetes at scale and leverage Workday’s vast computing resources on rich datasets to deliver transformative value to our customers. Sound like your kind of challenge?

You are a strong technical leader with deep Python expertise and solid machine learning engineering skills, capable of writing beautiful, well-designed code while delivering solutions efficiently. Specifically, you will:

Own exploration, design and implementation of features for our sophisticated ML platforms, pipelines and services.
Be responsible for evaluation, scalability and observability of these features.
Apply machine learning techniques including LLMs and natural language understanding to analyze large sets of HR and Finance-related text data, and design and launch pioneering cloud-based machine learning architectures
Stay up to date with advancements in AI, LLMs, RAG, autonomous agents and orchestration frameworks to drive innovation

About You

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s (Master’s or PhD preferred) degree in engineering, data/computer science, physics, math or equivalent
5+ years full-time professional experience as a member of a data science, machine learning engineering, or other relevant software development team building machine learning products from the ground up at scale. This includes taking products through applied research, design, implementation, evaluation, and production.
3+ years of full-time professional experience with Python and supporting libraries in production
3+ years of full-time professional experience with cloud computing platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP, etc.)

Other Qualifications:

3+ years of full-time professional experience in building information retrieval systems.
3+ years of full-time professional experience in machine learning and deep learning frameworks & toolkits such as Pytorch, TensorFlow, and Sklearn
3+ years of full-time professional experience with data engineering and data wrangling using e.g. Pandas and PySpark and other industry tools used to build scalable machine learning systems, such as Kubernetes and Docker
3+ years of full-time hands-on professional experience in developing ETL pipelines and inference services that use large language models (LLMs) and text generation models in production. This includes the full machine learning life cycle - data processing, model fine-tuning, model deployment and model evaluation
Deep understanding of statistical analysis, unsupervised and supervised machine learning algorithms, and natural language processing for information retrieval and/or recommendation system use cases
Ability to communicate clearly and effectively in a cross-functional setting with product managers, app teams, and leadership

Workday Pay Transparency Statement

As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here.

Our Approach to Flexible Work

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field
with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Staff Research Engineer — Conversational AI

As a Staff AI Research Engineer, you will drive the research and development of agentic AI systems that can reason over real enterprise data, execute complex workflows, and operate reliably at Fortune 500 scale.

You will work at the intersection of applied AI research and systems engineering, exploring new approaches to agent architectures, reasoning, orchestration, and evaluation, while translating promising ideas into robust production capabilities.

Agent architecture: Research, prototype, and develop advanced agent architectures and design patterns. Explore approaches to planning, reasoning, context management, tool use, memory, and multi-agent collaboration to improve the capabilities of enterprise AI agents.
Agent orchestration & harness design: Design and evolve the agent execution harness, exploring different orchestration strategies, control flows, and execution models for multi-step agentic workflows. Determine how agents should interact with tools, delegate tasks, manage state, and recover from failures.
Evaluation & benchmarking: Develop rigorous evaluation methodologies to measure agent capabilities across reasoning, task completion, accuracy, robustness, and efficiency. Build benchmarks, evaluation datasets, and systematic experimentation frameworks to compare architectures, models, and agentic approaches.
Reliability & agent behavior: Investigate failure modes in agentic systems, including non-deterministic behavior, reasoning errors, tool failures, and cascading execution issues. Develop techniques to improve agent reliability, predictability, and performance in complex enterprise environments.
Observability & behavioral analysis: Build instrumentation and analytical frameworks that provide visibility into agent behavior, execution trajectories, reasoning patterns, latency, and cost. Use production traces and behavioral data to identify limitations and drive iterative improvements.
Technical leadership: Set the technical direction for agentic AI research and development. Drive architectural decisions, establish experimentation standards, mentor engineers, and help the team develop a strong foundation in modern agent design and applied AI research.
Research-to-production engineering: Bridge the gap between research prototypes and production systems. Identify which approaches merit investment, validate them empirically, and work with engineering teams to turn successful experiments into scalable, maintainable enterprise AI capabilities.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

7+ years building production software systems with a strong track record on reliability, performance, and scalability
Hands-on experience shipping generative AI products — not just integrating LLM APIs or building prototypes, but owning AI-powered features that production users depend on
Solid depth in how large language models work: failure modes, context constraints, and how prompt design shapes model behavior at scale
Practical prompt engineering experience: systematically designing, versioning, and evaluating prompts across model updates or A/B evaluation cycles
A real track record in eval engineering — not just familiarity, but a portfolio of evaluation suites designed, shipped, and used to drive quality decisions in production AI systems
Cost and efficiency awareness at the system level: experience reasoning about model routing, inference cost, and latency tradeoffs in production
Strong software engineering fundamentals: distributed systems, API design, and testing discipline
Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous, startup-like AI product environments

Nice to Have

Experience with multi-agent coordination patterns (A2A, MCP)
Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
Prior experience shipping AI systems in enterprise software
Experience with AI observability tooling (tracing, cost tracking, LLM-specific monitoring)
Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure, service observability, logging, monitoring, reliability engineering, and production troubleshooting

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

The Opportunity

At Roche's AI for Drug Discovery (AIDD) group within the Computational Sciences Center of Excellence, we are building computational approaches that accelerate antibody discovery. Our focus is on translating machine learning models into portfolio impact—working directly with gRED and pRED scientists to apply developability prediction, design optimization, and functional modeling to real projects. We're looking for a talented Senior Scientist who combines strong technical expertise in developability and biophysics with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse scientific teams. In this role, you'll work on active portfolio projects, apply cutting-edge computational methods to real discovery challenges, and grow into broader leadership as you advance.

Antibody design is becoming increasingly computational. The scientists who can bridge computational methods and experimental reality—who understand both the science deeply and the practical needs of portfolio teams—are increasingly valuable. This role gives you the opportunity to have direct impact on real projects while building expertise in a rapidly evolving field.

In this role, you will:

Apply developability modeling to active portfolio projects in gRED and pRED, translating computational predictions into actionable guidance for antibody engineering teams
Support the continuation and evolution of our molecular assessment research efforts in partnership with Antibody Engineering stakeholders, ensuring continuity and quality of ongoing work
Interface with portfolio scientists and stakeholders to understand their scientific challenges and translate those into computational approaches; clearly communicate model outputs and limitations
Contribute to method development in developability prediction, biophysical modeling, and ML model improvement—identifying gaps in our current approaches and proposing solutions
Work with our modeling and platform teams to transition research-stage models into production-ready components that can be reliably used on portfolio projects
Develop technical relationships and credibility with gRED/pRED stakeholders, establishing yourself as a trusted resource for computational support in antibody design

Who You Are

Technical Foundation

PhD in Computational Biology, Biophysics, Chemistry, or related field, or equivalent advanced experience (5-8 years in ML/computational methods or biophysics)
Strong expertise in developability assessment, biophysical modeling, or antibody engineering; deep understanding of what makes antibodies druglike (expression, stability, biophysical properties, manufacturability)

Experience with molecular modeling tools, biophysical analysis, or related computational approaches
First-author publications or equivalent evidence of research contributions

You enjoy working with experimental scientists and translating their challenges into computational problems

You bring energy and curiosity to your work

You're willing to take on ambiguous problems and figure them out

added.description:
The Opportunity

Join the Proactive Communications & Notifications team as we build the systems that help Hinge Health determine what message a member receives, when they receive it, and which channel is most helpful. Our work brings together distributed backend services, data flows, and machine learning and AI capabilities to make member communication more relevant, timely, and actionable.

As an AI Engineer, you’ll build and operate the backend systems that bring AI-powered product capabilities to members. You’ll partner with senior engineers, ML Scientists, Data Engineering, Product, and other software engineers to design APIs, services, workflows, and data flows that are reliable in production.

This role is a strong fit for a backend-leaning software engineer who wants to apply distributed-systems skills to AI products. You’ll help integrate, deploy, and operate models and AI services within product systems; model training and research are not the primary focus. MLOps experience is valuable, but the core expectation is strong software engineering, production execution, and operational ownership.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months

Learn the Proactive Communications & Notifications domain, service architecture, operational practices, and member-impact goals.
Ship well-scoped improvements to APIs, services, asynchronous jobs, or workflows with guidance from senior engineers.
Build familiarity with the team’s testing, observability, deployment, and incident-response practices; participate in on-call or incident support as appropriate.

In your first 6 months

Own a medium-sized feature from planning through implementation, testing, rollout, and follow-up with minimal support.
Integrate an ML- or AI-backed capability into a product workflow through clear interfaces, reliable data flows, and appropriate failure handling.
Improve the correctness and operability of distributed systems by applying patterns such as retries, idempotency, versioning, graceful degradation, dashboards, and structured logging.

In your first year

Deliver multiple production initiatives that improve the relevance, timeliness, reliability, or maintainability of member communications.
Trace and resolve issues across APIs, services, queues, databases, model-backed components, and data dependencies, raising risks and decisions early.
Help strengthen the team through thoughtful code reviews, design documentation, pairing, onboarding support, and contributions to engineering practices.

Who You Are

You are a backend-minded software engineer who enjoys building reliable systems and learning how they behave in production.
You can take a well-scoped problem from design through launch, break work into incremental changes, and ask for direction when complexity or ambiguity increases.
You demonstrate effective communication through clear design notes, concise status updates, thoughtful code reviews, and early escalation of risks.
You are a learn-it-all who welcomes feedback, builds depth in your primary technologies, and develops the judgment to make sound tradeoffs.
You practice accountability by owning the quality, reliability, and follow-through of the systems you build.
You lead at all levels: you are hands-on in the details, contribute to a positive team culture, and help teammates succeed through collaboration and knowledge sharing.

Basic Qualifications

2+ years of non-internship, full-time professional software engineering experience.
Experience building and operating backend services or distributed systems in production, including APIs, asynchronous processing, event-driven systems, workflows, or data-intensive services.
Professional experience with at least one production programming language such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Java, Kotlin, or a comparable language, plus experience with software testing, observability, deployment, or production support.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience integrating ML- or AI-backed services into production products.
Experience with AWS or another cloud platform and technologies such as Docker, Kafka, PostgreSQL, or equivalent systems.
Experience with asynchronous processing, workflow orchestration, event-driven systems, or long-running state.
Familiarity with CI/CD, service monitoring, model deployment, inference, or model versioning.
Experience with Temporal, Step Functions, Kubernetes, Airflow, or comparable systems.
Experience with generative AI, LLMs, retrieval, agents, or evaluation systems.
Experience working in healthcare, digital health, fintech, or another regulated or data-sensitive domain.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

This is a hybrid role based in the San Francisco office, requiring in-person attendance three days per week for a full 8-hour business day. On remote days, employees are expected to work during core business hours with flexibility. The office is part of a dog-friendly workplace program.

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare – starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide.

With an AI-powered human-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain.

The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care – from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation – through personalized, evidence-based care.

As the preferred partner to 60+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2,800 employers.

The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore.

Learn more at hingehealth.com.

Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

added.description:
Responsibilities

The Transparency & Observability Data Science team builds the data, metrics, and analytical capabilities that help us understand how our enforcement systems perform. Our work supports both internal decision-making and external transparency reporting, while improving the reliability, explainability, and quality of Trust & Safety data.

As a Lead Data Scientist on this team, you will be the technical architect for how Trust & Safety measures, monitors, and explains itself. You will design the systems and data foundations behind our metrics, observability, and transparency reporting, and serve as the AI and data architecture lead who drives AI readiness across Trust & Safety.

Responsibilities:
- Architect Transparency & Observability Systems:
- Establish the Transparency & Observability architecture for Trust & Safety, covering metrics, data pipelines, monitoring, and reporting.
- Design end-to-end observability for the enforcement lifecycle, from detection and review to actions and outcomes, so that every enforcement decision can be traced, measured, and explained.
- Set standards for metric definitions, anomaly detection, and alerting, and make sure Trust & Safety reports one consistent view of its enforcement.
- Build Governed, AI-Ready Data Foundations:
- Set up data quality, lineage, and governance practices (SLAs, validation, reconciliation, documentation) so that Trust & Safety data is accurate, timely, and audit-ready for regulatory reporting.
- Design and oversee ETL pipelines and workflow orchestration that turn scattered inputs into reliable, well-documented data products.
- Build data systems designed for agent consumption across Trust & Safety, covering canonical data models, semantic layers, intelligent workflows, and evals.
- Drive AI Readiness and Technical Leadership Across Trust & Safety:
- Partner with Product, Engineering, Policy, Operations, Legal, and Comms to find high-impact opportunities where AI and data can improve operational efficiency and safety outcomes, and take solutions from experimentation to reliable production.
- Own the long-term technical roadmap for Trust & Safety observability and AI readiness, and lead the program and change management needed to land it across teams.
- Create reusable architecture principles, reference architectures, and best practices for responsible, explainable AI adoption across Trust & Safety teams, and mentor data scientists and engineers in applying them.

Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Analytics, or a related quantitative field, including technical leadership of cross-team initiatives.

- Strong SQL and Python skills.
- Experience building data quality, monitoring, or observability solutions, and designing metrics frameworks used across organizations.
- A solid understanding of AI architecture patterns (e.g. RAG, embeddings, knowledge systems) and responsible AI practices, applied to operational workflows.
- Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into technical strategy, and to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including leadership.

added.description:
About the role
Talkdesk partners sell and design Customer Experience Automation (CXA) solutions. This role makes sure they can deliver them. As the Applied AI Architect for EMEA, you are the design authority for partner-led paid pilots and production deployments of AI agents on the Talkdesk platform across the region.
You set the architecture, define what success looks like, and review the work at each gate. Where a use case or product area is new, you build it hands-on, then hand it to the partner. Your measure of success is a pilot that proves its value, reaches production, and leaves the partner able to deliver the next one alone.
This is a post-sales role on a new team. You will be the first senior Partner Delivery lead in EMEA, so you will work with a high degree of autonomy and help shape how Talkdesk works with partners on delivery.
What you'll do
Lead paid pilots

Scope each pilot with the partner and customer: use cases, success criteria, evaluation plan and the exit criteria for production.
Design the agent architecture: multi-agent orchestration, knowledge and retrieval, tools and integrations, guardrails and human handoff.
Account for data residency, GDPR and EU AI Act requirements in every design.
Build the hard parts hands-on when the pattern is new, then transfer the work to the partner team.
Report results against the success criteria and give a clear go or no-go recommendation for production.

Guide delivery to production

Run design reviews at discovery and pre-go-live gates across about 10 active partner projects, working hands-on in two or three at a time.
Review partner configurations, test results and evaluation results before go-live.
Act as the regional technical escalation point. Resolve what you can, and route the rest to Voice Engineering, Product and Engineering, or Professional Services.
Recognize when a project has outgrown partner-led scope and move it to Talkdesk delivery teams under agreed rules of engagement.

Make partners self-sufficient

Launch the partner certification program in EMEA, certify partner architects, and run onsite and virtual workshops.
Build reference architectures, design patterns and delivery playbooks from what works in the field.
Work closely with the EMEA Partner Solutions Engineering team so partners get a consistent handover from pre-sales to delivery.
Bring recurring patterns and product gaps back to Product and Engineering.
Support partners in other regions, such as APAC, when needed.

What you bring
8+ years in solution architecture, professional services or technical delivery for CCaaS or customer experience platforms, including leading enterprise implementations to go-live.
2+ years designing and shipping LLM-based or agentic solutions in production: prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, guardrails and evaluations.
Hands-on skills. You read and write code in Python or TypeScript and work comfortably with REST APIs, webhooks and OAuth.
Contact center depth: routing, IVR, omnichannel, telephony basics, and integration with CRM, workforce management and knowledge systems such as Salesforce, ServiceNow and Microsoft Dynamics.
A record of running pilots or proofs of concept against measurable success criteria and converting them to production.
Experience working through partners across several European markets, such as telcos, system integrators, VARs, resellers and BPOs, and a preference for coaching over doing the work yourself.
Working knowledge of European data protection and AI regulation as it applies to customer-facing AI.
Clear communication with both executives and engineers, in writing and at a whiteboard.
Professional fluency in English. German, Dutch, French, Spanish or Portuguese is a strong plus.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to have
Experience with Talkdesk products (Studio, Navigator, Autopilot, Copilot, Knowledge Management, Multi-Agent) or with another enterprise CCaaS or conversational AI platform.
Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent frameworks, and evaluation or observability tooling.
Delivery experience in regulated industries, especially financial services and insurance.
Experience building a certification or enablement program, or being the first hire of a function in a region.

About the Company

Our partner is a YC-backed company building a new kind of marketplace in the AI training data space. Rather than operating as a labor marketplace, they provide infrastructure that lets data producers transform their existing data into formats AI labs want and sell it directly to those labs. This democratized model unlocks far more high-value data sources, and the team is growing quickly to keep up with demand.
The Opportunity

This is the company's top hiring priority and a genuinely hard research problem. Because data flows through a decentralized marketplace, ensuring quality at scale is the single biggest bottleneck to growth. As a Research Engineer, you will build the automated systems that verify and assure data quality so that suppliers consistently deliver excellent data to buyers.
You will start by digging into the data manually to understand failure modes, then design systems to automate quality checks at scale, combining rule-based approaches with AI for fuzzier cases and human-in-the-loop review where it makes sense. This is fundamentally a research role focused on building automated systems, not manual QA.
Responsibilities

Identify data quality issues including inconsistencies, formatting problems, and ingestion challenges
Perform initial manual data quality review to deeply understand failure modes
Build systems to automate quality checks at scale using rule-based and AI-driven approaches
Design hybrid systems that balance automation with human-in-the-loop review where appropriate
Continuously improve verification methods as the data landscape and AI tooling evolve

Requirements

Deeply technical, with a strong learning slope and the ability to ramp quickly in a fast-moving field
Background in AI/ML engineering, or software engineering at an AI-focused company with visible data ingestion and processing experience
Ability to reason about likely data quality problems from first principles
Comfortable owning ambiguous, open-ended problems end to end
Comfortable working in person, full-time, in a San Francisco office
Bonus: experience working with noisy or unstructured data, or judgment on when to use automation versus human-in-the-loop review

NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Research Scientist to drive groundbreaking research at the intersection of AI, GPU computing, and Electronic Design Automation (EDA). AI and GPU acceleration are transforming the future of chip design, and this role offers the opportunity to shape that future.

What You'll Be Doing

Define and conduct original research across EDA algorithms, VLSI design methodology, and advanced machine learning techniques.
Innovate in EDA software and algorithms, with applications spanning supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning, as well as GPU-accelerated optimization methods.
Collaborate cross-functionally with circuit design, VLSI, and architecture teams, ensuring research translates into real-world product impact.
Engage with the global research community by publishing in premier conferences, presenting at leading venues, and driving thought leadership.
Foster collaboration with external researchers and diverse internal product teams to amplify research outcomes.

What We Need To See

Research Excellence: PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience), with 2+ years of post-PhD research experience and a strong record of impactful publications in top EDA and AI/ML venues; proven ability to set research direction and translate ideas into tools or products.
Domain & Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge in EDA/VLSI (e.g., synthesis, formal verification, timing, reliability, or physical design algorithms) combined with 5+ years applying AI techniques (supervised, unsupervised, RL) and GPU/accelerator-based computing to large-scale problems.
Programming & Systems Skills: 5+ years of experience in software development; strong expertise in high-performance computing, parallelism, optimization, and large-scale software engineering.
Leadership & Collaboration: experience in leading research projects or teams, with a track record of mentoring junior scientists, driving cross-functional initiatives with circuits/VLSI/architecture groups, and fostering collaborations with academia or industry.
Communication & Impact: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated experience presenting at top conferences; track record of releasing high-impact open-source tools, datasets, or frameworks; ability to influence both technical and non-technical audiences.

added.title: Senior ML Platform Engineer, Robotics
added.description:
The Bigger Picture

At Andromeda, we're building the social intelligence layer for humanoid robots - technology that

allows robots to understand people, build relationships and become a meaningful part of everyday life.

Our first robot, Abi, is already doing this in aged care and healthcare, where she brings conversation, companionship and engagement to people every day.

Now we're scaling from early deployments into a platform that can operate across thousands of real-world environments. We're looking for individuals who want to tackle hard problems across robotics and AI, and help define what it means for robots to live and interact alongside people.

The Role

You'll build the shared workflows behind our ML development: reproducible experiments, trustworthy evaluations, dependable training data, reliable training infrastructure, and models that integrate with the robot software we already run. You'll be the champion for ML developer experience, making the best-practice workflow the fastest and easiest path for the team.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll write the first implementation, help teams use it, and improve it against real workloads. Some days that means making a training job recover cleanly. Others, it means finding why a promising model behaves differently on Abi. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will lead by influence and set technical direction for ML tooling, not manage a team.

You'll partner with our existing DevOps, cloud, and robot software platform engineers and extend it for ML workflows.. Our stack includes, AWS, Nix, ROS 2, and NVIDIA Jetson, third party and custom tooling. What we need is strong MLOps judgment, the drive to learn, and an obsession with making your teammates' workflows effortless.

This role is on-site five days a week in SF

What You'll Own

Repeatable experimentation. Establish practical patterns for experiment repositories, configuration, code review, and automated checks. Build reusable libraries, scripts, and templates that let engineers start quickly without leaving behind work only its author can run
Data infrastructure. Build the multimodal data lake and pipelines that clean, annotate, and serve data for model training. Add quality checks and lineage so every dataset traces back to the robot data it came from
Experimentation and evaluations. Make it cheap to test new ideas against production baselines and challenger models, and clear when a candidate genuinely wins. Define the path a model follows: candidate, qualified against agreed criteria, approved, then deployed to the robot
Develop patterns for robot integration testing. Test the complete model path inside the existing robot codebase: inputs, preprocessing, inference, interfaces, and downstream behavior. Work with engineers on CI, simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop testing that catch failures that software only testing will miss
Cloud and training infrastructure. Own the ML-specific workflows for provisioning compute, scheduling and managing jobsWork with cloud and DevOps engineers on the underlying infrastructure, access, reliability, and cost
Reproducible environments and deployable models. Build reliable packages and dependency configurations. Learn and apply Nix packaging, the Nix store, and binary caches. Contribute to existing robot build and release workflows so models reach Jetson with compatible dependencies, tested runtime behavior, and a rollback path. Support staged rollouts or shadow deployments, and monitor how deployed models behave on robots in the field
Product-linked reporting. Build dashboards that connect model and dataset versions, evaluation results, and deployed performance to agreed product metrics. Help teams distinguish benchmark gains from improvements in Abi's behavior, reliability, and user experience
Adoption across the engineering team. Work alongside engineers to understand bottlenecks, advise on technical choices, and make shared tools useful in practice. Provide clear examples, documentation, and handoffs

Requirements

5+ or more years experience in ML infrastructure, developer platforms, and robotics software. You are comfortable working with robots and embedded systems.
You've built systems other engineers rely on and love to use, not just configured tools for your own experiments. You've built internal tooling adopted across multiple teams
Strong engineering, packaging, and dependency-management skills. You enjoy hardening production systems. You love breaking complex systems into maintainable, tested components and work confidently in an unfamiliar codebase
Practical experience with reproducible ML workflows, evaluation, experiment tracking, data lineage, and model artifacts. You know where lightweight conventions are enough and where automation earns its keep
Experience building data pipelines for ML training, including cleaning, annotation, and dataset quality checks, and training and evaluating classifiers
Experience operating cloud compute and training workloads, with sound judgment about reliability, observability, performance, and cost
Comfort debugging across model code, runtime environments, and robot interfaces, including hands-on testing with hardware.
Clear communication and collaborative judgment. You can advise senior engineers, agree ownership with adjacent teams, and support colleagues without becoming a bottleneck

Useful, but not required

ML model and code optimization for NVIDIA Jetson and cloud deployments, including quantization, mixed precision, inference compilation with TensorRT or comparable runtimes, and performance profiling across CPU, RAM, and GPU
Management of distributed training infrastructure, including multi-GPU and multi-node workloads, scheduling, checkpointing, and failure recovery
Experience integrating ML workloads with ROS 2-based robot software
Experience with Nix/NixOS and AWS.
Willingness to learn Nix packaging, store semantics, and binary caches. Prior Nix expertise is welcome, not required
Experience supporting simulation or on-robot evaluation systems,

added.title: Research Engineer, Beneficial Deployments
added.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most.

We're looking for a Research Engineer to make Claude better at the real-world work that matters most to Beneficial Deployments. You'll identify where our models fall short, build the environments and reward signals used to train them, run experiments, and measure whether new capabilities generalize beyond the training data. You'll also work closely with the Beneficial Deployments team, helping shape its roadmap based on where AI capabilities are heading.

Key responsibilities

Identify capability gaps in our models and turn them into a research agenda
Own the end-to-end process of creating RL environments, from task sourcing and reward design through training, using both real-world and synthetic data
Collaborate with domain experts to design data pipelines
Develop and improve QA frameworks to catch reward hacking and ensure env quality
Run generalization experiments to measure how data strategy changes improve model capabilities
Partner with other RL research teams and product teams to align on capability goals

Minimum Qualifications

Have experience with fine-tuning large language models for specific domains or real-world use cases
Have experience with reinforcement learning, reward design, or training data curation for LLMs
Have a track record of setting your own direction and delivering on ambiguous, high-stakes work with little oversight, such as by running your own team, research program, or company
Can turn deep technical understanding into clear strategic recommendations that influence senior, non-technical leaders
Think rigorously about how quickly AI capabilities are advancing and are ready to plan around the possibility that transformative AI arrives soon
Find value in reading through datasets to understand them and spot issues
Are excited about a role that combines hands-on applied research with strategy and influence

Preferred Qualifications

Have experience training production ML systems
Have experience designing evals or benchmarks for LLMs
Have domain expertise in healthcare, global health, or philanthropy
Have experience with multilingual models or low-resource languages
Have worked with NGOs, ministries of health, funders, or other partners in low- and middle-income countries

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$500,000—$850,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California:
We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

added.title: Senior Deep Learning Engineer, Cosmo 3D Spatial
added.description:
NVIDIA is at the heart of the AI revolution, and Physical AI is its next frontier: machines that perceive, reason about, and act in the three-dimensional world. NVIDIA Cosmos is our open platform of world foundation models for Physical AI, built to interpret images, video, and text and turn them into a structured understanding of a physical scene: motion, object interactions, geometry, and physical context. These models are the reasoning layer for robots, autonomous vehicles, and smart infrastructure.

The Cosmos Engineering team builds the foundational capabilities behind these models. We are hiring a Senior Deep Learning Engineer to own the data engine and end-to-end training verification behind the 3D spatial reasoning and perception capabilities of these models
: 2D and 3D grounding, metric geometry, spatial reference frames, cross-view correspondence, and embodied spatial reasoning. You will decide what the model learns geometry from, prove that it learned it, and work directly with research scientists in Cosmos Lab to turn 3D research hypotheses into measurable capability in shipped models. If you believe frontier model quality is won or lost in the data and the evaluations, this is the seat where that belief does the most work.

What You'll Be Doing

Own the 3D data engine for Cosmos spatial reasoning: source, curate, filter, and balance large-scale real-world image and video corpora into vision-language training data with the coverage and diversity that spatial understanding demands.
Build the annotation and auto-labeling pipelines that produce 3D-grounded supervision at scale, camera-relative 3D boxes, referring and spatial question answering, free space and reachability, ego-, world-, and object-centric reference frames, cross-view correspondence, camera motion, distance and size, and chain-of-thought traces, validated by programmatic and model-based critics.
Own data quality end to end: semantic deduplication, automated quality scoring for faithfulness, completeness, and correctness, coverage analysis across scene types and reference frames, and the sampling strategies that keep pre-training and supervised fine-tuning mixtures balanced.
Verify end-to-end model training: run and validate full pre-training and supervised fine-tuning pipelines, guard reproducibility, catch data and checkpoint regressions, diagnose throughput and loss anomalies, and attribute capability changes back to the specific data and recipe decisions that caused them.
Build and operate the 3D and spatial evaluation suite, public benchmarks such as CV-Bench, BLINK, RefSpatial, VSI-Bench, SPAR-Bench, and RoboSpatial, NVIDIA's VANTAGE-Bench for real-world fixed-camera video understanding, and in-house benchmarks you design with continuous evaluation and full traceability from every reported score back to the exact weights, inputs, configuration, and evaluation code.
Partner closely with Cosmos Lab research scientists: translate 3D research hypotheses into dataset and ablation experiments, run them at scale, and feed honest results back into recipe and architecture decisions.
Operate on large multi-node GPU clusters, tuning data throughput, sharding, and dataloader performance so that data is never the bottleneck on a long training run.
Ship the results into Cosmos releases, open-source datasets and benchmarks where appropriate, and raise the bar for data and evaluation rigor across the team.

What We Need To See

MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
12+ years of proven experience building deep learning systems in Python with PyTorch or JAX on Linux.
Deep expertise in 3D computer vision, multi-view geometry, structure-from-motion or SLAM, depth and camera pose estimation, point cloud processing, or 3D reconstruction with the practical ability to produce and validate 3D ground truth at scale, not just consume it.
Hands-on experience with vision-language models, including building the training data and evaluations that measurably improve visual grounding and reasoning quality.
Demonstrated experience building large-scale multimodal data pipelines: distributed video and image processing, deduplication, captioning and annotation, automated quality metrics, and dataset versioning.
Experience running and validating large model training on multi-GPU, multi-node clusters, with working knowledge of distributed training and sharding strategies such as data, tensor, and pipeline parallelism or FSDP.
Rigorous evaluation methodology: designing benchmarks that resist gaming, building clean ablations, and reading results honestly enough to kill your own ideas.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of partnering effectively with research scientists and translating research direction into engineering execution.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

PhD and/or publications at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, or CoRL in 3D vision, multimodal learning, or embodied AI.
Experience curating web-scale or petabyte-scale video corpora, and building the distributed processing infrastructure behind it using Ray, Spark, Slurm, or similar.
Familiarity with 3D foundation models and modern auto-labeling techniques for geometry, camera estimation, and correspondence.
Experience with vision-language model post-training, supervised fine-tuning, chain-of-thought data design, reward modeling, or reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards applied to reasoning quality.
Experience building evaluation infrastructure and harnesses such as VLMEvalKit, including leaderboards, dashboards, and example-level failure inspection.

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology industry's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and versatile people in the world working with us, and our engineering teams are growing fast in some of the most impactful fields of our generation: Deep Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Physical AI. If you're a creative engineer who enjoys autonomy and shares our passion for technology, we want to hear from you!

Overview

We're hiring an AI Engineer who can build a fraud model and also build the production system that runs it. Intuit's Consumer and Lending Risk team protects the lending products small businesses and consumers rely on: QuickBooks Capital loans and lines of credit, Credit Karma Line of Credit, and File Now Pay Later.

You'll own a lending product line end to end. You decide what to model and build the streaming and batch features it needs. You train and calibrate the model, deploy it to real-time serving, connect it to the rules engine where policy decisions are made, and monitor it in production.

The role combines AI science and ML engineering. You'll work daily with fraud policy, product, analytics and platform engineering. Your models make real-time decisions on real money.

Responsibilities

Own the production path, end to end

Data: define and instrument the data taps and event-bus topics your models need, with data contracts and named schema owners.
Features: build streaming aggregates, request-time features and batch features, with point-in-time-correct replay for training data.
Training: build reproducible training pipelines with scheduled retraining and recalibration.
Serving: deploy models to real-time and batch serving with online/offline parity, latency budgets and safe fallbacks.
Decisioning: integrate scores into the rules engine with policy partners, so each decision records whether a rule, a model or a fallback made it.
Monitoring: own dashboards, drift and data-quality alerts, decision logs, and on-call for your model's decision path.

Do the science

Frame fraud problems with policy: patterns, label definitions, label maturity and the cost of each action.
Build calibrated models (gradient-boosted trees, deep and sequence models) whose probabilities a decision can price.
Design shadow-mode, champion/challenger and holdout experiments, and read the results with Decision Science.
Handle what makes fraud data hard: delayed and partial labels, unseen outcomes for declined applications, and fast-changing attacks.
Document models for model risk management, fairness review and bank-partner validation.

Raise the engineering bar

Write production-quality code with tests, code review, CI/CD and versioned artifacts.
Turn what you build once into reusable patterns other AI scientists can self-serve.

MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Math, Operations Research or a related field, or a BS with equivalent experience.
2+ years of industry experience building ML models, including at least one you deployed and operated in production.
Strong Python and SQL, plus Spark or a similar distributed framework.

Experience building data or feature pipelines on event streams (for example Kafka) or a workflow orchestrator (for example Airflow).

Clear communication with non-technical partners such as policy and product.
