added.title: Data Scientist
added.description:
About Hammerhead

Hammerhead AI tackles one of the hardest problems in AI: the collision between exploding compute demand and the hard limits of the power grid. Our platform uses reinforcement learning to coordinate power, cooling, and compute in real time, unlocking more AI capacity from data centers that are already built. Our founders built and scaled AutoGrid, the AI grid-software company acquired by Schneider Electric
. Our oversubscribed $10M seed round
was led by Buoyant Ventures with SE Ventures, and we are part of NVIDIA Inception. Learn more at hammerheadco.ai
.

About The Role

We’re hiring a Data Scientist to build the forecasting and optimization behind our platform: working out how much more AI capacity a running data center can safely take, and proving it. You’ll work directly with our reinforcement learning and engineering teams on the problem every AI company now has: power.

Hammerhead unlocks usable power inside data centers that are already built and already carrying customer load. Working out how much more capacity a site can take, and under what conditions, is a hard quantitative problem under real uncertainty, with physical and commercial consequences if the answer is wrong. You’ll own that problem: forecasting, scenario modeling and optimization applied to real infrastructure, where the answer has to hold up both operationally and commercially.

In your first 90 days you’ll get to know our site data and existing models, take ownership of the forecasting pipeline for live site assessments, and set up the backtesting that tells us how far we can trust each model. Success in your first year means production forecasts and capacity assessments that our commercial and delivery teams rely on, documented well enough to stand up to customer and external technical review.

This is a full-time, on-site role in our Redwood City office, working alongside our reinforcement learning and platform engineering teams. You will report to the Head of Engineering & Product.

Key responsibilities

Forecasting: Build and own probabilistic load forecasts for data center sites across operational and planning horizons.
Capacity under uncertainty: Model site behavior to quantify available capacity and how confident we can be in it.
Optimization: Develop the optimization across power, cooling and storage that turns forecasts into operating decisions.
Validation: Build the backtesting and validation framework that tells us when a model is good enough to rely on.
Production: Instrument and monitor models in production, and improve them as sites, hardware and workloads change.
Decisions, not just models: Turn model output into decisions the business can act on, and explain how the model works, what it found and what it means to non-technical colleagues and customers.
Documentation: Document methodology to a standard that survives customer and external technical review.
Collaboration: Work closely with reinforcement learning, platform engineering, solutions and delivery so models fit the decisions each team has to make.

Qualifications

Required

3+ years building forecasting or optimization models that ran in production and that people depended on.
Have taken a model from prototype to deployment and owned it in production, including support.
Strong in probabilistic forecasting and Monte Carlo simulation.
Experience with time series at scale, including messy, incomplete telemetry from physical equipment.
Strong Python scientific stack (NumPy, pandas, SciPy) plus an optimization library such as Pyomo, CVXPY, Gurobi or CPLEX.
Experience with control optimization, control theory or energy optimization.
Bachelor’s or Master’s in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or a related quantitative field.
Clear communicator, in writing and in person, with technical and business colleagues.
Able to work on-site in our Redwood City office, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Preferred

Experience with data center power and cooling, or industrial process telemetry.
Energy domain experience: distributed energy resources, virtual power plants, battery dispatch, demand response or wholesale market optimization.
Comfort with reinforcement learning or model predictive control.
Work where model error carried financial consequences: pricing, revenue management, capacity planning or trading.
Uses AI coding and analysis tools day to day to move faster.

added.description:
About Us

Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. Founded in 2017, product launched in 2019, and achieved profitability in 2024.

Why We Exist

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).

Why We’re Hiring

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

As Our Business Continues To Expand, There Is Growing Demand For More Data Science Team Members. We Are Hiring 2-3 People To Drive Impact In These Areas

Growth Marketing
Product Development
Strategic Partnerships

On leveling:
You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.
No corporate fluff: The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals.
Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end.

What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Data Science & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.
Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.
Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

Who You Are

First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"
Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.

Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.
What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.
It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS*

Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options

And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays
Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.
Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION

As a member of the Applied Algorithms and Autonomy team, you will design, build, and deploy core machine learning and AI capabilities for True Anomaly. You will work with a talented cross-functional team to advance technology at the intersection of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data-driven decision-making. This will involve hands-on development across areas including object classification and discrimination, anomaly detection, and threat assessment. You are a first-principles engineer who takes ownership of the systems you build and delivers results.

Responsibilities

Design, implement, and test ML/AI models that support threat assessment, object discrimination, and decision-making in operationally relevant environments
Own the full ML development lifecycle — from data ingestion and feature engineering through model training, evaluation, and production deployment
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate operational requirements into robust, production-ready ML capabilities
Establish and maintain rigorous model evaluation practices to ensure reliability and performance in real-world conditions
Write clean, well-documented, and testable code in support of AI/ML capabilities

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, machine learning, data science, electrical engineering, or a similar discipline
Proficient in Python
Solid understanding of statistics, probability, and optimization
Experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX
4+ years of experience designing, training, and deploying ML models in real-world systems
Demonstrated ability to work in a multidisciplinary team and solve complex problems from first principles
Passion for spaceflight and advancing capabilities related to space domain awareness and space security

Preferred Skills And Experience

Master's or PhD in machine learning, computer science, data science, or a related discipline
Strong background in one of the following core ML disciplines:
Anomaly & outlier detection: statistical, density-based, and deep learning approaches
Object discrimination: multi-class and fine-grained classification, metric learning, few-shot learning, evidential reasoning and Dempster-Shafer Theory (DST) for belief combination and conflict resolution under uncertain or incomplete sensor data
Unsupervised learning: clustering, dimensionality reduction, generative modeling
Sequential and temporal modeling: time-series analysis and sequential modeling

Experience deploying models to edge or resource-constrained environments with real-time processing requirements
Familiarity with space domain data such as space object catalog data, observational data, or RSO characterization
Experience with MLOps tooling: experiment tracking (MLflow, W&B), model versioning, CI/CD for ML pipelines
Background in model interpretability, uncertainty quantification, or safety-critical ML validation

Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

Work environment—the work environment; temperature, noise level, inside or outside, or other factors that will affect the person's working conditions while performing the job.

added.description:
Purpose Of Position

We are seeking an experienced Senior AI Engineer to serve as a hands-on technical lead and primary builder within the Data Governance Team. This individual will design, build, deploy, and operate governed, auditable agentic solutions on the Bank's Databricks foundation. The role combines production engineering and architecture judgment, with direct responsibility for translating business needs into scalable AI capabilities that deliver measurable value in a regulated environment.

Essential Job Functions

Act as a hands-on lead engineer and primary builder, writing production code and delivering agents and LLM applications while shaping the Bank's AI architecture on Databricks.
Design, build, test, deploy, and operate production agents using retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, multi-agent, supervisory, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
Build and integrate Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients and servers; author secure custom tools and APIs; and establish reusable patterns for tool discovery, permissions, execution, and error handling.
Lead prompt and context engineering, model selection, evaluation, and token-usage optimization to improve quality, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency.
Configure and operate Databricks AI Gateway as the control point for model and agent access, including routing, access policies, rate limits, usage logging, cost controls, and guardrails.
Establish agent identity and authorization patterns, including on-behalf-of and delegated identity approaches, so agent actions are properly attributed, authorized, and auditable.
Partner with business stakeholders across credit, lending, relationship banking, and other functions to understand context and requirements and translate them into agent scope, delivery plans, and acceptance criteria.
Manage backlog priorities and trade-off decisions across business value, risk, cost, complexity, and delivery timing; drive adoption and measure and communicate business KPI impact.
Collaborate with BI engineers to architect dashboards that monitor agent cost, accuracy, usage, performance, traceability, and business outcomes.
Partner with Information Security on AI observability by identifying relevant control-plane and agent telemetry, defining signals for enterprise SIEM platforms such as Google SecOps or Splunk, and recognizing anomalous patterns that warrant investigation.
Partner with data stewards and data engineers to certify data sources and enforce classification, lineage, and entitlements through Unity Catalog.
Integrate agents across platforms using Salesforce Data Cloud and Agentforce, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and MuleSoft.
Collaborate with Information Security, Model Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Internal Audit to develop governance standards, documentation, control evidence, and testing artifacts.
Build CI/CD, automated testing, evaluation, and operational monitoring for AI workloads; mentor junior engineers; evaluate vendors and implementation partners; and perform other duties as directed.

Knowledge, Skills And Experience Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience; Master's degree preferred.
7+ years of experience in software, data, or machine learning engineering, including 2+ years delivering LLM or agent-based solutions to production.
Demonstrated experience delivering agentic capabilities in a regulated industry that produced measurable business value and scaled beyond proof of concept; financial services experience preferred.
Strong Python and SQL skills with hands-on production experience using Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Databricks AI Gateway or a comparable LLM gateway.
Experience building and integrating MCP clients and servers, developing custom tools, implementing tool-calling workflows, and securing agent access to enterprise systems and data.
Strong prompt and context engineering skills, including model selection, evaluation design, token-usage optimization, and cost/performance trade-off management.
Knowledge of agent identity and authorization patterns, including on-behalf-of and delegated identity models.
Experience implementing guardrails for cost, accuracy, safety, observability, and end-to-end traceability of LLM and agent workloads.
Experience working directly with non-technical business teams to define scope, manage prioritization trade-offs, drive adoption, and connect AI delivery to measurable business outcomes.
Understanding of AI and data governance, model risk management, privacy, and data security in a regulated environment.
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to influence technical, business, risk, and executive stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Production experience with LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or an equivalent agentic orchestration framework.
Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud and Agentforce, MuleSoft, or Microsoft Copilot Studio.
Experience with MLflow tracing, inference tables, or comparable LLM observability tooling.

Databricks or Azure AI certifications.

Our client is a healthcare AI company building conversational agents that ease the staffing crunch and paperwork load on clinical teams. Their agents hold real phone conversations with patients every day, handling scheduling, billing questions, prescription refills and post-discharge follow-ups for hospitals, medical groups and community health centres.

Design, build and ship AI agents end to end: conversation flows, prompts, tool calling, retrieval, memory and the backend services behind them

Improve instruction following, tool-calling reliability, latency and cost across the LLM and speech stack
Dig into real conversations and failure cases, then fix what you find in the prompt, tools, model or product

Work with product, clinical and customer teams to turn real care workflows into dependable agent behaviour

Real ownership: put several production agents in front of patients with health system partners in your first three months
A mission that matters: making healthcare work better for the people who use it
A small team with direct access to senior engineering leadership, where your work ships fast
Real conversation data to learn from every day, not a research seat

5+ years in software engineering, including at least a year shipping LLM-powered products in production
Strong in Python and/or TypeScript, comfortable across APIs and data, with enough frontend to finish a feature
Hands-on with prompting, function calling, RAG, structured outputs and agent orchestration
Experience designing evals and using data to decide what to fix next

Clear communicator with engineers, clinicians and executives alike
A plus: voice AI (speech-to-text, text-to-speech, turn-taking, telephony), healthcare or other regulated-industry experience (HIPAA, FHIR), or workflow orchestration experience

If you want to look back in a year and know that patients talk to something you built every single day, let’s talk.

The Senior AI/ML Data Platform Engineer will be expected to design, build, and operationalize machine learning infrastructure and AI-driven data solutions on AWS. The successful candidate will bridge data engineering and MLOps, ensuring scalable, secure, and compliant AI/ML pipelines that support advanced analytics and decision-making across programs.
The AI/ML Data Platform Engineer creates and/or maintains operating systems, communications software, database packages, compilers, repositories, and utility and assembler programs. This position is responsible for modifying existing software and developing special-purpose software to ensure efficiency and integrity between systems and applications.

Key Responsibilities

Design and implement end-to-end ML pipelines including data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, validation, and deployment on AWS (SageMaker, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions).
Build and maintain MLOps infrastructure: model registries, CI/CD for ML models, experiment tracking (MLflow or SageMaker Experiments), and automated retraining pipelines.
Develop scalable feature stores and data preprocessing pipelines using AWS Glue, EMR, or Spark on Databricks.
Partner with data scientists and analysts to productionize models and translate research prototypes into robust, maintainable systems.
Ensure ML systems meet government data security, privacy (PII/PHI handling), and compliance requirements (FISMA, NIST).
Implement data versioning, lineage tracking, and model explainability/audit capabilities.
Monitor deployed models for drift, performance degradation, and data quality issues; implement alerting and automated remediation.
Contribute to data platform architecture decisions, including lakehouse design, data cataloging (AWS Glue Data Catalog / Apache Atlas), and access controls.
Document architectures, pipeline designs, and operational runbooks to government documentation standards.

Education:
This position requires a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university with a major in computer science, information systems, engineering, business, or other related scientific or technical discipline. Three (3) years of equivalent experience in a related field may be substituted for the Bachelor’s degree. (Note: A Master’s degree is preferred.)

General Experience:
The proposed candidate must have twelve (12) years of computer experience in information systems design. Other experience required:
6+ years of data engineering or software engineering experience, with 2+ years focused on ML platform or MLOps engineering.
Deep expertise with AWS ML/AI services: SageMaker, Glue, EMR, Lambda, Step Functions, Kinesis, S3.
Strong Python skills; experience with ML frameworks (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost).
Experience building and maintaining MLOps pipelines and CI/CD for ML workflows.
Solid understanding of distributed computing (Spark/EMR) and large-scale data processing.
Familiarity with government data security requirements and experience operating in FedRAMP-authorized AWS environments.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation).

Specialized Experience:
The proposed candidate must have at least ten (10) years of experience in IT systems analysis and programming including the following:
Experience with generative AI / LLM integration (AWS Bedrock, LangChain) in enterprise or government contexts.
Knowledge of responsible AI, model governance, and bias detection frameworks.
Experience with real-time/streaming ML pipelines using Kinesis or Kafka.
Familiarity with data mesh or federated data architectures.
Background in healthcare, public health, or social services data (HIPAA/42 CFR Part 2 awareness).

Preferred Certifications

AWS Certified Machine Learning — Specialty
AWS Certified Data Analytics — Specialty
AWS Certified Solutions Architect — Associate or Professional
Databricks Certified Associate Developer for Apache Spark

added.title: Sr. Engineer, AI Agentic Platform
added.description:
One of Confiz's largest retails clients is investing in AI as a core driver of retail innovation, and the AI Agentic Platform team is building the shared foundation that makes it possible. Our platform enables AI agents to autonomously reason, use tools, coordinate across systems, and take action on behalf of customers and business teams, powering experiences across commerce, personalization, inventory, and customer service.

As Senior Engineer, you are a lead individual contributor responsible for the quality of a team’s work and capable of tackling complex design and problem solving without supervision. You will design systems spanning multiple weeks or months of work, make technical decisions that balance short and long-term business objectives, and take ownership of team-level costs and metrics. You will champion new techniques, mentor junior engineers, and be a key technical voice in cross-functional discussions.

This is a hybrid role based in Seattle, WA. Onsite presence of 4 days per week is expected with an 8:00 am - 5:00 pm work schedule.

Responsibilities

Design and build core AI Agentic Platform capabilities, including agent orchestration layers, tool-use pipelines, memory systems, and APIs that enable product teams across the company to deploy AI agents.
Own end-to-end solution design for platform components spanning multiple engineers’ work, with full upstream/downstream integration consideration.
Apply AI fluency to integrate LLM APIs, embedding models, vector stores, and RAG patterns into platform services; evaluate and adopt emerging agentic frameworks as appropriate.
Make and clearly articulate technical trade-offs between short-term delivery needs and long-term platform scalability, factoring in design, component choice, and infrastructure costs.
Design systems accounting for current and upcoming product cycles, team-level cost responsibility, and alignment with cross-functional roadmaps.
Lead design and code reviews across the team; provide actionable feedback and maintain a high bar for quality, testability, and extensibility.
Design key metrics, events, and observability patterns for platform components; drive accountability for performance and security of feature work.
Work with business, infrastructure, and security teams to deliver enhancements, reliability improvements, and bug fixes for production AI systems.
Surface potential design or delivery conflicts in the current or upcoming product cycle and make clear recommendations on the best path forward.
Mentor and support junior engineers across a wide spectrum of technical activities; participate in hiring interviews with clear, specific feedback.
Ensure own work and team members’ work follows the company’s engineering and security standards; contribute to those standards.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong track record of designing and delivering complex, scalable distributed systems.
AI Fluency — Required: Hands-on experience working with LLMs, foundation model APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.), prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures, and embedding-based search in production environments.

Amazon is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building revolutionary robotic systems that combine cutting-edge AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced mechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This role presents an opportunity to shape the future of robotics through innovative applications of deep learning and large language models.

We leverage advanced robotics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to solve complex operational challenges at unprecedented scale. Our fleet of robots operates across hundreds of facilities worldwide, working in sophisticated coordination to fulfill our mission of customer excellence.

We are pioneering the development of robotics foundation models that:

Enable unprecedented generalization across diverse tasks
Integrate multi-modal learning capabilities (visual, tactile, linguistic)
Accelerate skill acquisition through demonstration learning
Enhance robotic perception and environmental understanding
Streamline development processes through reusable capabilities

The ideal candidate will contribute to research that bridges the gap between theoretical advancement and practical implementation in robotics. You will be part of a team that's revolutionizing how robots learn, adapt, and interact with their environment.

Join us in building the next generation of intelligent robotics systems that will transform the future of automation and human-robot collaboration.

As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will lead the development of machine learning systems that help robots perceive, reason, and act in real-world environments. You will set technical direction for adapting and advancing state-of-the-art models (open source and internal research) into robust, safe, and high-performing “robot brain” capabilities for our target tasks, environments, and robot embodiments. You will drive rigorous capability profiling and experimentation, lead targeted innovation where gaps exist, and partner across research, controls, hardware, and product teams to ensure outputs can be further customized and deployed on specific robots.

Key job responsibilities

Lead technical initiatives for foundation-model capabilities (e.g., visuomotor / VLA / video-action worldmodel-action policies), from problem definition through validated model deliverables.
Own model readiness for our embodiment class: drive adaptation, fine-tuning, and optimization (latency/throughput/robustness), and define success criteria that downstream teams can build on.
Establish and evolve capability evaluation: define benchmark strategy, metrics, and profiling methodology to quantify performance, generalization, and failure modes; ensure evaluations drive clear roadmap decisions.
Drive the data + training strategy needed to close key capability gaps, including data requirements, collection/curation standards, dataset quality/provenance, and repeatable training recipes (sim + real).
Invent and validate new methods when leveraging SOTA is insufficient—new training schemes, model components, supervision signals, or sim↔real techniques—backed by strong empirical evidence.
Influence cross-team technical decisions by collaborating with controls/WBC, hardware, and product teams on interfaces, constraints, and integration plans; communicate results via design docs and technical reviews.
Mentor and raise the bar: guide junior scientists/engineers, set best practices for experimentation and code quality, and drive a culture of rigor and reproducibility.

Basic Qualifications

PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
Strong hands-on deep learning expertise, with demonstrated impact in one or more: multimodal modeling, imitation learning/RL for robotics, vision-language/video models, sim2real/real2sim.
Proven track record leading technical projects end-to-end (problem framing → execution → measurable outcomes), with strong experimental rigor and reproducible baselines.
Strong software engineering skills (Python + C++/Java), ability to build reliable training/evaluation infrastructure and production-quality research code.
Demonstrated technical contributions (publications/patents/open-source or substantial internal impact) and ability to communicate technical direction clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience driving robotics foundation models (VLA/visuomotor/video-action/world-model-based policies) and multi-task robot learning.
Experience building evaluation/benchmarking systems that meaningfully guide roadmap and model iteration.
Experience with scaling (large-scale data, distributed training, inference efficiency/latency optimization).
Experience with real-robot experimentation and sim↔real pipelines; comfort partnering across controls/hardware teams.

Serve as a quality gate for our AI services: hold the bar on design, testing, and scalability, and review the changes that matter most before they ship.

Build a review culture that scales: clear architecture guidelines, common patterns to follow and avoid, design review templates, and risk-based review tiers, including AI-assisted review, so that quality holds as PR volume grows.

Prior principal or staff-level experience on a platform other teams build on.

About The Role

Gallatin AI builds AI-driven logistics planning and decision support for military operations. Our AI team is growing quickly, and we are hiring a Principal AI Engineer to be a technical anchor for it: someone who sets the engineering bar, owns architecture and scalability, and helps the team design, build, review, and ship its own work with high quality, in close partnership with our platform and backend teams.

We are looking for an exceptional engineer with broad range and sound judgment. You have designed systems that other engineers build on, you make the people around you better, and you care as much about how a team builds as what it builds. Deep AI experience is a plus. Deep engineering judgment is the requirement.

What You Will Do

Serve as a quality gate for our AI services: hold the bar on design, testing, and scalability, and review the changes that matter most before they ship.
Be accountable for how our AI services integrate with our event-driven backend (NATS-based messaging), data models, and APIs, working with platform and backend engineers to keep those integrations safe, scalable, and consistent.
Be a trusted code reviewer for the AI team, including changes into shared backend and data systems
Build a review culture that scales: clear architecture guidelines, common patterns to follow and avoid, design review templates, and risk-based review tiers, including AI-assisted review, so that quality holds as PR volume grows.
Prevent architectural drift. Make sure engineers working in parallel, with or without AI coding assistants, are building toward the same design instead of undoing each other’s work.
Own scalability: set latency, throughput, concurrency, and cost targets, find bottlenecks, and fix them. Ask “what happens at 10x?” before things ship.
Write production code on difficult problems, including AI-specific backend features, agent and retrieval services, and data pipelines.
Lead design reviews and RFCs and drive them to decisions. Know when infrastructure or data model changes are safe and how to roll them out without breaking existing systems.
Make build-versus-buy and model-selection calls, including self-hosted versus cloud tradeoffs under data-handling and deployment constraints.
Unblock the AI team’s access to data sources, infrastructure, and tooling so they can move on their own.
Mentor engineers, grow future technical leads, and help set the hiring bar.

What You Bring

10+ years of software engineering, with a record of designing and scaling complex production systems through multiple orders of magnitude of growth.
Principal-level backend and distributed systems depth: service design, event-driven and message-based architectures, APIs, data modeling, concurrency, caching, and failure handling.
Demonstrated trust as a code and architecture gatekeeper for a team or platform, and a track record of spreading that capability across other engineers.
Strong computer science fundamentals, applied with judgment.
Deep Python fluency, plus strong TypeScript or comparable full-stack experience.
Production experience with, or the demonstrated ability to quickly ramp on, LLM systems such as RAG, agents, tool use, and evaluation.
Strong testing and observability instincts, including reliable tests around nondeterministic components.
Working fluency with cloud infrastructure, containers, and CI/CD. You can ship what you build.
Clear written and verbal communication with engineers, product leaders, and customers.
Eligibility for a US security clearance.

Bonus Points

Prior principal or staff-level experience on a platform other teams build on.
Experience scaling an engineering organization’s practices, such as review, design standards, and onboarding, as headcount tripled.
Experience with data platforms, feature stores, or ML pipelines.
Experience with optimization, simulation, or logistics systems.
Experience in constrained, air-gapped, or regulated deployments.
Background in military logistics, planning doctrine, or defense programs.

Role Overview

We are looking for a talented and driven Senior AI Engineer
to join the Pinnacle AI (PinAI) team at DoubleVerify. In this role, you will be a core builder of AgentOS
— our agentic AI platform that powers conversational, intelligent experiences across the Pinnacle advertising analytics suite.

You will design and implement AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and LLM-backed tools that allow Fortune 500 clients to interact with their advertising data through natural language. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who is passionate about applied AI, thrives in a fast-moving environment, and wants to see their work directly impact how the world's largest advertisers make decisions.

Location:
New York, NY (Hybrid)

What You'll Do

Agentic AI Development

Design, build, and maintain AI agents within the AgentOS framework using architectures based on MCP (Model Context Protocol), LangChain, LangGraph, and related tooling
Develop new MCP servers and tools that expose Pinnacle analytics capabilities — including metrics, dimensions, settings, and user data — to AI agents
Implement multi-turn conversational flows, tool-use reasoning chains, and agent orchestration logic that handle complex, real-world advertising analytics queries
Build and maintain the chat UI integration layer, connecting AgentOS to the Pinnacle front-end experience

LLM Engineering & Optimization

Work with major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others) to select, prompt, and integrate models appropriate for specific agent tasks
Develop and own prompt engineering strategies, including system prompts, few-shot examples, and chain-of-thought techniques
Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ground AI responses in Pinnacle's proprietary data and documentation
Continuously optimize model performance through evals, latency tuning, and cost management

Evaluation & Quality

Build and maintain evaluation (evals) frameworks that measure agent accuracy, instruction-following, hallucination rates, and user satisfaction
Define quality benchmarks and run regression evals on every agent change before production deployment
Instrument agents with observability tooling (e.g., LangSmith, Weights & Biases, or custom tracing) to support debugging and continuous improvement

Integration & Platform Engineering

Integrate AgentOS with Pinnacle's existing platform services — including PIAM/Keycloak authentication, Settings APIs, and analytics data layers
Collaborate with backend teams to build and consume APIs that surface data cleanly and securely to AI agents
Participate in architecture reviews and contribute to technical design documents for new AI-powered features

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Supports the delivery of solution or infrastructure development services for AI/ML initiatives, applying strong technical capability and hands-on engineering experience. Contributes to the design, development, delivery, and maintenance of AI-enabled solutions or infrastructure while aligning to relevant engineering standards and project delivery expectations. Understands business and user requirements and helps translate them into sound technical designs and implementation plans. Contributes to the integration of AI/ML capabilities into broader enterprise solutions, with a focus on quality, scalability, and user impact.

Design, develop, test, deploy, and support production-grade AI/ML, generative AI, and intelligent automation solutions.
Solve complex technical problems through coding, debugging, testing, troubleshooting, and structured design remediation.
Translate business and user requirements into technical designs, APIs, workflows, and supportable implementation patterns.
Build and integrate LLM, RAG, and agentic solution components into enterprise applications and platforms.
Contribute to system design across service boundaries, orchestration layers, data flows, security controls, and external integrations.
Support project delivery through disciplined execution, estimation, documentation, status communication, and risk identification.
Partner with Development, Engineering, Product, Data, Architecture, and project leadership teams to deliver high-value AI capabilities.
Improve performance, resilience, maintainability, and cost efficiency of deployed AI systems.
Participate in architecture and design reviews, providing thoughtful trade-off analysis and implementation input.
Use modern AI-assisted software engineering tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent agentic coding platforms as part of day-to-day engineering delivery.

AI and Engineering Skills:

Gen AI Foundational:

Ability to understand business challenges and translate them into value-add AI solutions leveraging large language models and intelligent automation

Proficiency in prompt engineering techniques including zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, and structured output design, with the ability to systematically evaluate and iterate on prompt performance(e.g. DSPy, PromptFlow etc.)

Agentic and LLM Ops:

Experience designing and building agentic systems including multi-agent orchestration patterns, tool use, and memory design across single and multi-step workflows (e.g. LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, NVIDIA NIM etc.)
Ability to build reliable agent loops including failure handling, retries, fallbacks, and context window management across complex multi-step agentic workflows
Ability to debug, troubleshoot, and remediate production LLM and agentic systems including failure diagnosis across retrieval, orchestration, and generation layers
Experience designing and implementing LLM evaluation frameworks covering functional correctness, output quality, safety, and business-defined KPIs (e.g. RAGAS, DeepEval, Arize Phoenix etc.)

Software Engineering:

Hands-on software engineering proficiency in Python, with the ability to write clean, modular, production-quality code for LLM pipelines and agentic applications
Experience working with structured and unstructured data sets to support LLM application development, including data curation, preparation, and quality validation for model inputs
Familiarity with RESTful and event-driven API patterns including asynchronous workflows, service boundaries, and integration of enterprise data sources to expose LLM and agentic capabilities
Familiarity with containerization and orchestration concepts for packaging and deploying LLM applications in cloud environments (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Container Apps, AWS ECS etc.)
Understanding of software engineering best practices as applied to ML systems, including modular code design, testing patterns for AI pipelines, and data quality validation

Soft Skills and additional attributes for success:

Clear communicator able to explain complex AI system behavior and trade‑offs to technical and non‑technical stakeholders, including risk and compliance.
Strong ownership and accountability, taking responsibility for AI systems from design through production and issue resolution.
Comfort with ambiguity, able to operate effectively as requirements, regulations, and technologies evolve.
Collaborative and cross‑functional, working closely with engineering, product, risk, legal, and audit teams.
Sound judgment in regulated environments, with awareness of risk, controls, and when human oversight is required.
Bachelor’s degree preferred.
3+ years of applied engineering experience, including meaningful experience in AI/ML engineering roles.

Demonstrated experience in the following areas will be a huge plus:

Ability to build and maintain model observability pipelines including tracing of multi-step agentic reasoning chains, output degradation detection, and behavioral drift monitoring in production (e.g. LangSmith, Arize, Datadog, Azure Monitor etc.)
Familiarity with LLM fine-tuning approaches including instruction tuning and preference optimization, with an understanding of when fine-tuning is appropriate versus prompt-based solutions (e.g. LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, NeMo Framework etc.)
Familiarity with inference optimization principles — latency, throughput, and cost management — to support scalable and cost-effective LLM deployment
Familiarity with AI security considerations relevant to LLM systems, including prompt injection risks, adversarial input handling, and audit trail requirements
Familiarity with responsible AI principles including bias and fairness evaluation, human-in-the-loop design, and explainability approaches in the financial services contexts
Familiarity with data pipeline design for AI workloads including ingestion, transformation, and quality validation
Familiarity with cloud-based platforms for building, training, and deploying scalable LLM solutions (e.g. Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, Google Vertex AI etc.)
Familiarity with AI-assisted software engineering tools for accelerating development, implementation, and code review practices (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex etc.)

Master’s degree in Business Administration (MBA) or Science (MS) preferred
Prior consulting experience

Our client is seeking a Machine Learning Led to own the fraud and risk intelligence layer at the core of our platform.

added.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
added.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You'll Be Doing…

As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer within Verizon’s Transformation Command Center (TCC), you will embed directly into the frontline of Verizon’s core Business Units to solve our most critical, ambiguous, and high-stakes operational challenges. Operating with technical ownership, you will help to architect, build, and deploy production-grade agentic systems, enterprise RAG engines, full-stack microservices, and decision systems into live operations.

You are a technical anchor: you pair deep systems craftsmanship with a product mindset, cutting through operational ambiguity to design production architectures, implement custom orchestration layers (via LangGraph, Temporal, or custom state machines), and enforce context management strategies that scale into enterprise assets. Beyond shipping point solutions, you will run workloads reliably on Domino, Airflow, and Kubernetes, abstracting bespoke code into reusable SDKs, shared libraries, and architectural playbooks that scale company-wide.

Responsibilities Include

End-to-End Architectural Understanding: Utilize the full-stack architecture for embedded AI initiatives, including multi-agent orchestration, state machines, latency/cost budgets, security boundaries, and enterprise back-end integrations.
Agentic Orchestration Engineering, Workflow Automation and Governance: Implement stateful agent workflows complying with established agentic governance rules, using tools like LangGraph, Temporal, or event-driven state machines, establishing strict protocols for tool calling, execution sandboxing, and deterministic fallback logic.
Context & Retrieval Systems: Design production RAG infrastructure incorporating hybrid search, re-ranking algorithms, metadata filtering, and semantic caching, directly informing and scaling Verizon’s context architecture.
Runtime & Cloud Deployment: Deploy production agent services and scheduled workflows to target runtimes (e.g., Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes microservices, and serverless compute across AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Evaluation Harness Design: Architect offline and online evaluation frameworks (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge, synthetic test generation, human-in-the-loop review queues, live A/B rollouts) to measure model drift, context hallucination rates, and task completion metrics.
Platform Codification: Generalize custom domain deployments into reusable internal SDKs, API primitives, and modular UI components
Strategic Discovery & Scoping: Embed alongside BU leadership to map intricate operational processes, cut through organizational noise, and isolate the highest-leverage intervention points where applied AI delivers measurable uplift.
Executive Translation: Serve as a technical engineer in the room with Directors and above, demystifying algorithmic behaviors, failure modes, and performance trade-offs.

What We're Looking For…

You'll need to have:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field or four or more years of work experience.
Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Extensive hands-on experience leveraging frontier LLMs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini) and agentic developer frameworks (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to build scalable solutions and achieve core business milestones.
Three or more years of shipping production software and/or demonstrated experience deploying LLM applications, agentic workflows, or autonomous tool-calling pipelines into production.
Strong proficiency in Python and modern TypeScript/Node.js for full-stack API integration and backend orchestration.
Experience with containerized deployments (Docker), API design, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Proven track record implementing both offline evaluation benchmarks and online evaluation/observability pipelines (latency, token costs, hallucination tracking, eval-driven development).
Proven experience deploying containerized services and data workflows across enterprise platforms such as Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), and hyperscaler cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure).
Advanced full-stack programming mastery in Python, SQL, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript stacks.
Proven track record designing offline/online eval harnesses, guardrail frameworks, and observability systems (latency, token optimization, tracing).
Demonstrated ability to independently scope ambiguous technical initiatives and present architectural designs to senior executive stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to interface directly with enterprise stakeholders, translate ambiguous business requirements into technical architectures, and lead project delivery end-to-end.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

Bachelor or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related technical field.
Experience building and scaling centralized context platforms or enterprise search engines similar to Verizon's internal enterprise context layer platforms.
Prior forward-deployed engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting experience in top-tier technology firms or hyperscalers.
Record of turning one-off operational builds into enterprise-wide shared libraries, with associated technical publications or filed patents.
Domain knowledge in telecommunications, network capacity optimization, capital planning, or large-scale customer care operations.
Deep expertise in retrieval and context architectures: designing production RAG pipelines, vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Milvus, Pinecone), hybrid search (dense + sparse/lexical), and dynamic context management.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

The salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $81,000.00 - $155,000.00.

added.title: Principal AI Platform Engineer
added.description:
Job Summary

Homeland Talent Solutions is partnering with a leading healthcare technology organization to identify an exceptional Principal AI Platform Engineer
to transform how software engineering teams build, test, and deliver applications through advanced agentic AI.

This is a highly technical, hands-on individual contributor opportunity focused on designing and building a greenfield AI engineering platform. The Principal AI Platform Engineer
will develop autonomous agent frameworks, create reusable AI development tools, and integrate agentic workflows into existing software environments. The long-term vision is to create an AI-powered software development factory where engineers define specifications, autonomous agents handle implementation, and human reviewers validate code changes.

Reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer, the Principal AI Platform Engineer
will serve as a senior technical authority while remaining actively involved in writing code and delivering production systems. This is not a traditional AI leadership, consulting, or strategy position; the organization is seeking a true builder with hands-on experience developing and operating sophisticated agentic AI systems in production.

Responsibilities

Agentic AI Platform Development

Design, develop, and operate a scalable AI agent platform supporting enterprise software engineering workflows
Build autonomous agents that interact with existing codebases, development tools, APIs, and approved enterprise systems
Develop agent orchestration frameworks that translate engineering specifications into implemented code changes and pull requests
Create reusable agent templates, frameworks, APIs, SDKs, and MCP-based tool integrations
Establish technical standards for agent execution, tool access, and integration across engineering teams
Write production code and deliver functional reference implementations

AI Engineering Enablement & Developer Productivity

Enable software engineering teams to adopt AI-assisted development workflows with consistent, measurable results
Establish shared agent templates, context-management strategies, rules files, and reusable engineering capabilities
Improve engineering productivity, software quality, and delivery efficiency through AI-powered automation
Partner with engineers to integrate AI tools into existing applications and development environments
Define performance metrics for AI adoption, development velocity, software quality, and cost efficiency
Build a foundation for the long-term adoption of autonomous software engineering capabilities

AI Evaluation, Security & Reliability

Develop evaluation frameworks to measure agent accuracy, output quality, and performance over time
Establish monitoring, tracing, observability, and operational controls for AI workloads
Implement human-review checkpoints, execution limits, retry controls, and token and cost safeguards
Design secure agent integrations with authenticated tool access and appropriate data isolation
Establish practices to protect sensitive information across AI prompts, logs, and system interactions
Troubleshoot production issues and continuously improve agent reliability, scalability, and performance

Technical Architecture & Innovation

Evaluate emerging AI models, frameworks, coding agents, and orchestration technologies
Design solutions that support multiple programming languages, application architectures, and cloud environments
Develop effective context-engineering and retrieval strategies for large enterprise codebases
Collaborate with Engineering and Product teams to identify opportunities for integrating AI capabilities into software products
Serve as a senior technical advisor to the CTO while maintaining substantial hands-on development responsibilities

Requirements

10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including recent hands-on production coding
Approximately 3+ years of experience building and operating production agentic AI systems
Demonstrated experience personally developing autonomous AI agents capable of executing workflows and interacting with external tools or codebases
Hands-on experience building and operating unattended autonomous agents, beyond interactive AI assistants or supervised demonstrations
Strong Python programming skills and proficiency with modern AI engineering frameworks
Experience with agent orchestration technologies such as LangGraph, LangChain, or comparable frameworks
Experience developing MCP servers, APIs, SDKs, or equivalent authenticated agent tool interfaces
Strong understanding of large language models, generative AI, context engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation
Experience deploying and operating AI systems within cloud infrastructure
Experience implementing AI evaluation, observability, security, and production safeguards
Ability to develop reusable AI capabilities across multiple software applications and technology stacks
Strong technical communication skills and demonstrated ability to influence and mentor engineering teams
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Foundry, Azure DevOps, and Kubernetes, preferred
Experience integrating AI agents into C#/NET applications, preferred
Experience with AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or similar platforms, preferred
Familiarity with OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs, preferred
Experience with MLflow, LangSmith, or comparable AI evaluation and observability platforms, preferred
Experience with vector databases, Azure AI Search, and retrieval infrastructure, preferred
Experience supporting large legacy codebases and enterprise software modernization, preferred
Experience building secure AI solutions in regulated or data-sensitive environments, preferred
Familiarity with healthcare technology, electronic health records, or revenue cycle applications, preferred

Benefits

This role offers a competitive projected annual base salary of $230,000–$250,000, depending on experience and qualifications, a comprehensive benefits package, and a hybrid work arrangement based in Dallas, TX, requiring approximately 3–4 days onsite per week.

Summary

This is a unique opportunity to build a greenfield AI engineering platform, work directly with the CTO, and influence how approximately 200 software engineers develop and deliver applications across an established healthcare technology organization. If you're a highly technical, hands-on AI engineer ready to shape the future of autonomous software development and take ownership of a transformative initiative, we encourage you to apply today!

Job Title: AI Engineer

Job Location: Austin, TX (onsite)

Project Duration: 12 months with possible extension

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Role Summary

We are hiring an AI Engineer to design, build, and operate agentic AI systems — LLM-powered agents that reason over enterprise data, call tools, and execute multi-step workflows end to end. This is a hands-on engineering role at the center of how we automate complex technical and operational work. You will take ambiguous problems, decompose them into agent workflows, and ship production services that engineering teams depend on daily.

This is an ideal role for an engineer with a strong Python and ML foundation who has already shipped LLM or RAG applications and now wants to go deeper into orchestration, tool-calling, and autonomous multi-agent architectures. You will work within an established platform and architecture, with senior engineers available for design review — but you will own your components from prototype through production.

Key Responsibilities

Agent Design & Orchestration

Build and ship LLM-powered agents that plan, call tools, and complete multi-step tasks using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent orchestration libraries.
Implement multi-agent workflows — planner, executor, reviewer, and specialist roles — including state handling, hand-off logic, retries, and graceful failure paths.
Design and expose tools to agents via function-calling and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, wrapping internal APIs, databases, and enterprise systems as safe, well-scoped agent capabilities.
Retrieval & Knowledge Systems
Build and operationalize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines: chunking, embedding, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, and context assembly.
Integrate structured, semi-structured, and unstructured sources — SharePoint, Confluence, Jira, REST APIs, Excel, and SQL warehouses — into retrieval and agent context layers.
Continuously improve answer grounding and reduce hallucination through better retrieval, prompt design, and context management.

Engineering & Deployment

Develop production Python services and APIs for agent and model inference using FastAPI, containerized with Docker and deployed through standard CI/CD pipelines.
Instrument agents with tracing, token and cost accounting, latency monitoring, and structured logging so that behavior is observable and debuggable in production.
Apply MLOps and LLMOps practices including version control for prompts and configs, automated regression testing, and safe rollout of model or prompt changes.

Evaluation & Quality

Build evaluation harnesses for agent workflows — golden datasets, task-level success metrics, LLM-as-judge scoring, and regression suites that gate releases.
Measure and tune for accuracy, latency, and cost, and make explicit trade-offs between them based on the use case.

Collaboration

Partner with domain experts, data engineers, and product stakeholders to turn manual workflows into reliable automated agents.
Deliver results through interfaces users actually adopt — Streamlit apps, chat interfaces, dashboards, and embedded integrations.
Write clear design notes and runbooks, and participate actively in code and design reviews.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of professional software, ML, or data engineering experience, including at least 1 year building LLM-based or GenAI applications.
Strong Python engineering skills — not just notebooks. Production code, testing, packaging, async patterns, and API development with FastAPI or similar.
Hands-on experience with at least one LLM orchestration framework (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or an equivalent) in a shipped application.
Demonstrated experience building RAG systems: embeddings, vector stores (e.g., FAISS, pgvector, Pinecone, Chroma), and retrieval quality tuning.
Practical command of prompt engineering, structured output, function/tool calling, and context-window management.
Working knowledge of SQL and cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, or equivalent), and comfort writing queries against enterprise schemas.
Experience containerizing and deploying services with Docker and shipping through CI/CD on a major cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
Solid grounding in ML fundamentals and familiarity with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or HuggingFace Transformers.
Clear written and verbal communication, and the judgment to escalate when a problem is under-specified rather than guessing.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building or consuming Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, or comparable agent tool-integration layers.
Production experience with multi-agent or agentic workflow systems, including human-in-the-loop checkpoints and approval gates.
Familiarity with LLM observability and evaluation tooling such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Weights & Biases, or MLflow.
Experience with workflow orchestration tools — Airflow, Dagster, Prefect — or analytics engineering with DBT.
Exposure to model fine-tuning or parameter-efficient adaptation (LoRA/PEFT) and knowing when it is — and is not — the right answer.
Background in a technical engineering domain (semiconductor, hardware validation, manufacturing, or similar) where agents operate over specialized data.
Experience with AI governance, responsible-AI review, or enterprise security requirements for LLM deployments.

Description

We are seeking a Senior Applied Scientist to push the state of the art in robot learning and help bring capable robots out of the lab and into everyday homes at Fauna Robotics. In this role, you will design novel algorithms across perception, manipulation, sim2real transfer, reinforcement learning, and multi-task learning, closing the gap between research and real-world deployment.

You will work where robotics research meets production systems. You'll combine hands-on technical work with scientific leadership to guide the team toward the most promising directions. Working closely with software engineers and scientists, you will turn new ideas into robust solutions for dynamic, unstructured home environments. Homes bring challenges that structured settings like warehouses don't, and consumer-grade sensors and actuators have real limits, so this work calls for creative, out-of-the-box approaches.

Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.

At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.

The Opportunity

As a GenAI Python Systems Engineer – Senior Associate, you will build AI systems that help clients turn data and models into useful decisions and more efficient processes within our Advisory practice. This role focuses on taking generative AI beyond experimentation by developing Python-based components for retrieval, agent workflows, and model evaluation. You will contribute to production-ready solutions that connect with client platforms, support human review, and make system behavior easier to monitor and improve. Working alongside data scientists and engineers, you will help shape how these capabilities address practical business needs.

As a Senior Associate, you will manage assigned workstreams while building meaningful client relationships and understanding how your technical decisions support broader engagement goals. You will review work produced by junior colleagues, offer guidance that develops their skills, and use feedback to sharpen your own. Throughout delivery, you will uphold professional and technical standards while adapting your approach to different perspectives and changing business contexts.

Responsibilities

Designing Python-based generative AI systems that turn client data into actionable insights and automate business processes using machine learning and natural language processing
Building context pipelines with hybrid retrieval, reranking, structured memory, and prompt caching to supply language models with useful information for client applications
Implementing agent workflows with tool orchestration, permission controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and guardrails to support traceable automation in production environments
Integrating AI models and services with client platforms through APIs and Model Context Protocol interfaces, considering governance, portability, and workload requirements
Developing evaluation processes that use benchmarks, calibrated model scoring, and human review to assess model behavior, identify failure patterns, and guide improvements
Testing, deploying, and monitoring model-driven systems with Python, tracing, and operational feedback to refine performance after launch
Managing assigned engineering workstreams by translating client needs into technical designs and deliverables while resolving complex data and integration challenges
Reviewing junior engineers’ code and technical outputs, providing actionable feedback, and coordinating with client stakeholders and project teams as requirements change

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 3 years of experience

Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Analytics/Data Science, Artificial Intelligence/Robotics, Computer Science/Information Systems, Engineering

Building Python-based AI systems that move machine learning applications into production
Applying natural language processing and retrieval techniques to generative AI workflows
Integrating model evaluations, guardrails, and tracing into AI engineering workstreams

Key Responsibilities

Own the delivery of LLM-powered systems in Python and TypeScript, from an ambiguous customer problem, scoped with product managers and data scientists, through production operation.
Set the evals and guardrails strategy for your area: what gates a release, what production signals the team watches, and how a change is simulated against historical claims before it ships.
Raise the bar for how the team works with agentic coding tools: sharpen the specifications, instruction files, hooks, and permission policies they run under, and hold generated code to the same review standard before it merges.
Design the NLP pipelines that turn unstructured claim data into structured data customers can act on, choosing where semantic search, classical NLP, or an LLM fits.
Build and operate durable, event-driven, multi-tenant systems in which agents run as steps inside deterministic workflows, designing their failure modes, replay semantics, and cost profile before they show up under load.
Own tracing and audit for your area: every model call and agent step recorded, so any recommendation can be reconstructed and cited back to its sources by on-call and auditors alike.
Set the privacy and security baseline every system in your area starts from: tenant isolation, least-privilege access for agents and their tools, redaction, retention, and what data may reach a model provider.
Author the design documents for complex systems to get feedback and buy-in, review other engineers' designs and code with the same care, and mentor the engineers in your area.
Take part in a shared on-call rotation for the systems you own.

Requirements

6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including an LLM-powered system you architected, shipped to external customers, and carried through at least one model or prompt migration.
Python and TypeScript at the level of setting a team's conventions: the async model, typing strictness, and test strategy for a shared codebase, plus a performance problem you profiled and fixed.
An evals and guardrails strategy you set for a product area others built in: where human approval was required, and how production corrections re-entered the evals.
A clear account of how you constrain an agentic coding tool's context and verify its output, from daily use of Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar on production work, plus changes you turned back, and why.
Pipelines you designed that blend LLMs, semantic search, and classical NLP, including a retrieval design you can defend and a case where a classical technique beat an LLM on cost, latency, or reliability.
Durable, event-driven systems you designed with deterministic orchestration around non-deterministic model steps: compensating actions, idempotency, backpressure, and event-sourced replay.
Data modeling and development across relational, document, and graph databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Neo4j, including when each type fits and the partition-key, consistency, and tenant-isolation calls you made.
Systems architected and operated on Azure or AWS, with CI/CD and infrastructure as code, and hands-on time with a durable workflow engine such as Temporal or the Durable Task Scheduler.
Technical design documents you have authored for systems that span more than one team, used to get feedback and buy-in before building, and that those teams then built to.
Clear writing and discussion for technical and non-technical audiences: drawing out a customer's real problem and explaining the trade-offs back to them.

Even Better If You Have

React and TypeScript experience, so you can deliver a full-stack feature end to end, especially chat, streaming, and citation-heavy AI experiences.
Experience with agent frameworks, LangGraph, PydanticAI, and the Microsoft Agent Framework among them, and with the ways agents reach their tools: the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, command-line tools, and microservices.
Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling such as LangSmith, Arize, or Braintrust, and with OpenTelemetry-based tracing.
Experience designing A/B tests for AI features.
Exposure to the insurance, claims, or automotive repair domains.

What Success Looks Like

In your first six months, every model change in your area is gated by evals you designed, regressions are caught before a customer sees them, and you can show the accuracy number held or moved.
You are trusted with the high-stakes, ambiguous problems, and you turn them into a roadmap, a shipped system, and a number you can put in front of a customer.
You are energized by what agentic coding tools make possible. Your team ships more than its headcount suggests, and your specifications and reviews are why the output survives production.
You have a passion for systems that last: the ones you design have their failure modes understood in advance, and when one fails anyway, the trace says exactly where.
Privacy and security reviews of systems in your area find nothing that was not already designed in.
Standards you set for evals, reviews, and design documents outlive the project they started on.
Engineers you mentor ship LLM-powered features with evals and guardrails in place without your direct involvement.
You enjoy getting a product manager, a data scientist, and a customer's team into one room and coming out with a single agreed scope, and you can argue a position without needing to win it.
You embrace our ambitious, collaborative, and empathetic values, and you like problems where the answer has to be measured rather than argued.

Description

The Creative X team within Amazon Advertising builds AI systems that understand and evaluate ad images and videos, so advertisers of every size can deliver high-quality experiences to customers. In this role, you will build image and video models that recognize what a creative contains, check whether it meets quality and brand requirements, and measure its effectiveness with measurable precision and recall.

We invest in computer vision, video understanding, vision-language models (VLMs), multimodal representation learning, and evaluation science, including calibrating automated judges against human judgment. A central challenge is making these models work at scale: you will use techniques such as model distillation so that image and video understanding can run across billions of ad impressions. You will join a team of applied scientists, product managers and software developers, own science components from prototype to production, ship advertiser-facing features, and contribute to publications.

Key job responsibilities

Build and improve image and video understanding models that extract semantic metadata from ad creatives, such as objects, products, scenes, text overlays, logos and brand elements, and shot-level events in video.
Develop models and metrics that detect visual production defects (for example distorted products, garbled text, and temporal artifacts in video) and check whether creatives follow the brief, with measurable precision and recall.
Apply methods through methods like distillation (and other techniques) to make efficient image and video understanding models, that are ready for production and can run at the scale of billions of daily ad impressions.
Calibrate automated image and video judges against human annotations, using preference learning and active learning to raise agreement with expert reviewers.
Run experiments, analyze the results, and turn findings into production improvements together with engineering and product partners. Share results in design reviews, documents and research publications.

About The Team

The Creative X team within Amazon Advertising is on a mission to democratize access to high-quality ad creatives for advertisers worldwide. We build the AI systems that determine what a creative contains; whether and why it will resonate with customers, working across images, video, audio, and text at Amazon-scale volume; and then serve the most performative ads to customers based on their personas. If you are excited about pushing the boundaries of applied AI in a space where your models directly influence the advertising experience for millions of customers, we would love to hear from you.
