As a profitable, bootstrapped start-up, we are led by a team of industry veterans in performance marketing, ad tech, and digital publishing. Together, we’re building the premier platform to incubate, scale, and optimize digitally born businesses, setting new standards for data-driven success.

Our entrepreneurial team brings proven experience from both global corporations and fast-growing startups. We’re passionate about delivering scalable, profitable outcomes for our partners through advanced profiling, targeting, and continuous optimization. Joining Moxxi means becoming part of a growing start-up in the heart of NYC, where you’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your career, expand your skill set, and shape the future of performance marketing.

Headquartered in New York City, Moxxi has recently opened a collaborative office designed for focus, creativity, and purposeful execution. Every project reflects our belief that excellence is built on discipline, curiosity, and integrity.

Moxxi Digital is a proud honoree of Crain's Best Places to Work in NYC 2026.

We are just getting started and invite you to join us as we continue to build something remarkable.

The Opportunity

As Engineering Leader for Machine Learning & Ad Platform at Moxxi, you'll be a hands-on technical leader who can architect production systems, build and ship the machine learning models that drive our revenue, and lead the teams that do both. You'll own the intelligence at the core of our performance marketing engine — the ranking, prediction, targeting, and optimization models that decide which offer is shown, where, and to whom — along with the low-latency platform that serves those decisions on every impression and click. You'll personally design, prototype, and productionize data science and ML solutions, set the technical direction for our ad platform, and lead one to two engineering teams (spanning platform engineering, ML, and data) and the products they own. You'll partner directly with the CTO, Product, and our Ad Ops and Account Management teams to turn revenue goals into models, systems, and measurable results. If you want to be the person who writes the model, designs the system around it, proves its lift with a clean experiment, and builds the team that scales it, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Machine Learning & Data Science (Hands-On)

Design, build, and ship production ML models for ad ranking and decisioning, including click, conversion, and revenue prediction (pCTR, pCVR, EPC, and RPI) that determine which offers and placements are served.
Develop optimization algorithms for bidding, budget pacing, and traffic and yield allocation that maximize revenue and advertiser outcomes under real-world constraints.
Build audience, lookalike, and targeting models that identify high-value users and improve campaign performance across publishers and placements.
Own the full model lifecycle: problem framing, exploratory analysis, feature engineering, training, offline evaluation, online deployment, monitoring, and retraining, in Python with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or XGBoost/LightGBM.
Design and run rigorous online experiments (A/B tests, multi-armed bandits, holdouts) with sound statistical methodology, and translate results into clear go/no-go decisions.
Build the ML platform foundations on GCP — feature pipelines and feature store, training pipelines, model registry, real-time inference, and model monitoring — using Vertex AI, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and Dataflow.
Apply LLMs and agentic workflows where they deliver measurable value, such as AI-assisted campaign setup, creative and offer generation, content classification, and operator copilots in Moxxi's ad ops platform.
Partner with Data Engineering to ensure event, tracking, and attribution data in BigQuery is accurate, timely, and fit for both billing and model training.

Technical Leadership & Platform Engineering

Own the architecture and technical roadmap for Moxxi's ad platform, including ad serving, real-time decisioning, tracking, and campaign management.
Stay hands-on in the codebase — designing, building, and reviewing production code in Golang (backend services) and Python (ML and data services), and guiding React work on operator-facing applications.
Design low-latency, high-throughput serving systems that run model inference within strict performance budgets for latency, throughput, and cost, using Redis, Docker, and Kubernetes (GKE).
Build and maintain integrations with advertisers, affiliate networks, publishers, and ad tech partners via APIs, postbacks, and real-time event pipelines.
Own system and model reliability end to end — observability, alerting, on-call, incident response, and blameless post-mortems — using tools like Datadog.
Set and uphold engineering and ML standards: code review, testing, CI/CD, reproducible training, model validation, and design reviews.
Make pragmatic build-vs-buy, heuristic-vs-model, scope, and sequencing decisions, balancing speed to market against long-term maintainability.

People Leadership & Team Building

Lead one to two engineering teams — spanning software engineers, ML engineers, and data scientists — and the products they own, with clear charters, goals, and success metrics.
Directly manage, mentor, and grow engineers through regular 1:1s, clear expectations, actionable feedback, performance reviews, and career development; develop tech leads as the teams grow.
Own hiring for your teams — define roles and the hiring plan, run technical and ML interviews, close candidates, and onboard new team members.
Run the teams' delivery cadence: planning, estimation, prioritization, and tracking, with predictable, high-quality releases across both software and model launches.
Raise the technical bar through example — coaching engineers on system design, modeling, experimentation, and ownership.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Work closely with the CTO, Product, Ad Ops, and Account Management to translate business goals and operator needs into scoped, prioritized technical and ML roadmaps.
Communicate model performance, experiment results, tradeoffs, risks, and timelines clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including leadership.
Stay current on ML research and industry changes (privacy regulation, signal loss, partner platform changes) and their impact on Moxxi's models and platform.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 5+ years building and deploying machine learning systems in production.
3+ years leading engineering teams as an engineering manager or tech lead manager, including hiring, performance management, and leading multiple engineers or teams.
Hands-on experience building ranking, recommendation, prediction, or optimization models for ads, search, recommendations, or marketplaces — from feature engineering through online deployment.
Production-level fluency in Python and the ML stack (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or gradient-boosted trees), plus strong backend development skills in a compiled language (Go, Java, Scala, or similar).
Strong grounding in statistics, experimentation design, and causal measurement, with a track record of using online experiments to drive product and business decisions.
Proven track record designing and operating low-latency, high-throughput, highly available distributed systems, including real-time model serving.
Experience building ML infrastructure: data and feature pipelines, training pipelines, model deployment, and model monitoring.
Strong data skills — advanced SQL, data modeling, and large-scale data processing on a cloud data warehouse or big data platform.
Experience building and deploying on a major cloud provider (GCP, AWS, or Azure) with containerization and orchestration.
Comfort with ambiguity and a track record of making sound, defensible tradeoffs with incomplete information in a fast-moving environment.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain models and results to technical and business stakeholders alike.

Nice to Have / Bonus Qualifications

Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
Direct experience in AdTech or performance marketing, especially ads ranking, real-time bidding, budget pacing, lookalike targeting, or conversion and attribution modeling.
Familiarity with programmatic concepts (OpenRTB, DSPs/SSPs, auctions) and performance marketing economics (CPA, CPC, EPC, CTR, revenue per impression, ROAS).
Experience with GCP's ML and data stack, including Vertex AI, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, and GKE.
Experience with deep learning for ranking (e.g., deep cross networks, transformers, sequence models) and distributed training.
Experience with mathematical optimization (linear/integer programming), reinforcement learning, or contextual bandits applied to allocation or bidding problems.
Experience building LLM-powered and agentic product features, including evaluation frameworks, and using AI-assisted development workflows.
Experience with event streaming technologies (Kafka, Pub/Sub, or equivalent) and real-time feature computation.
Hands-on experience with Golang and a modern front-end framework such as React.
Startup experience — moving quickly, wearing multiple hats, and building teams and ML capabilities from an early stage.
Awareness of privacy regulations and compliance relevant to advertising and consumer data (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, TCPA).

Who We Are

At Firestorm, we are building the future of expeditionary defense manufacturing and autonomous systems. Modern conflict has exposed a fundamental problem: the systems needed most by operators are often too expensive, too slow to produce, and too difficult to sustain at scale. Firestorm exists to change that.

We develop mission-adaptable aerial systems and deployable manufacturing infrastructure designed to put capability directly into the hands of the warfighter. From modular unmanned aircraft to xCell — our deployable microfactory — our goal is to make defense systems rapidly deployable, adaptable, and producible at the point of need.

We are looking for builders, operators, and problem-solvers who want to work on meaningful technology with real-world impact.

About the Role

Firestorm builds uncrewed aircraft and the manufacturing network that produces them: full-capability plants, deployable xCell edge factories, and forward-deployed sites that stand up production near the point of need.

Crucible is the software that runs that network. It combines production planning, execution, supply chain, and manufacturing data into a common model of how production operates.

We are hiring a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to build the applied AI systems behind Crucible. You will work alongside data science and software engineering to productionize optimization and ML models, integrate foundation models into the platform, and build AI-assisted workflows grounded in Crucible's manufacturing data and system model.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a research position. We are looking for someone who has shipped ML and AI capabilities into real products and understands what it takes to make them reliable, measurable, and useful after the prototype works.

Build AI systems end-to-end
— Design model interfaces, retrieval, tool use, orchestration, evaluation, and the services required to run them in production.
Select and evaluate models
— Choose models and approaches based on capability, reliability, latency, security, and deployment constraints.
Build for constrained environments
— Support AI capabilities in cloud, air-gapped, and edge deployments where external model APIs may not be available.
Ground AI in real operations
— Work with manufacturing, supply chain, and product teams to turn operational problems into useful AI features.
Set the technical direction for applied AI
— Establish patterns, evaluation methods, and engineering standards for how AI is used across Crucible.

Job Description:

At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. We're tackling the world's toughest health challenges, building a world where complex diseases are prevented and cured, treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Across Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine and Johnson & Johnson MedTech, our work is grounded in a single purpose: changing health for humanity. Johnson & Johnson is ranked #1 in healthcare across S&P 500 companies in the AIDE Institute's AI adoption index, which assesses how AI is applied in practice across workforce, operations and business outcomes, including work in surgical robotics, digital surgery analytics and imaging systems. At J&J, AI accelerates innovation, improves how we operate, and delivers better outcomes for patients.

The Principal AI Engineer, GenAI Platform Operations is the senior technical authority for how agents run on the enterprise GenAI platform: you set the operations strategy and build the capabilities that observe and control agents in production. That platform includes the MCP (Model Context Protocol) Gateway, the agentic runtime, conversational AI and content-generation services, and Enterprise Knowledge Graph and GraphRAG retrieval services, deployed across Microsoft Azure and AWS and relied upon by scientific, commercial, supply chain and manufacturing teams across our segments. As agents move from pilots into production, keeping the platform available is no longer enough: we need to know what every agent is doing, how well it is performing, and how to intervene while it runs. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you define that strategy and design and build the control capabilities that deliver it: observability and performance telemetry for agents, a map of agent performance and dependencies across the estate, reliability checks carried out by agents rather than by hand, and a runtime control plane that can throttle, pause, roll back or stop an agent, a tool or a model in seconds, including a tested kill switch. You also own agent lifecycle management at runtime, from registration and promotion through versioning, suspension and retirement, and you lead the platform's support and incident management teams. Because this platform supports regulated and patient-adjacent work, these controls are a quality and safety obligation as much as an engineering one, and you will partner closely with Quality and Compliance and with Information Security & Risk Management (ISRM) so that every control is validated, every control action is traceable, and the platform remains inspection-ready.

You lead the GenAI platform support and incident management teams, and you work with the site reliability, operations and platform engineers, setting the technical standards they operate to and mentoring them through the hardest failure modes. You set the runtime readiness criteria every agent must meet before it is promoted to production, and you turn agent performance signals, including quality regressions, failing tools, unreliable dependencies, runaway cost and unsafe behavior, into prioritized input for the Azure and AWS platform engineering, agentic engineering, model engineering, and AI security and governance teams. Guided by Our Credo, you build an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual, diversity and dignity are respected, merit is recognized, and on-call and escalation work is distributed justly and sustainably.

This position will report into the Senior Manager, TS GenAI platform engineering.

Key Responsibilities:

Define and own the GenAI platform operations strategy and roadmap — the operating model for running agents in production across Azure and AWS, the observability and control capabilities the platform needs, and the sequence for building them — and publish the agent operations review that turns performance, reliability, risk and cost trends into prioritized platform commitments.
Build the agent observability platform — end-to-end traces across multi-step agent runs, gateway-mediated MCP tool calls, model calls and retrieval, built on OpenTelemetry and its generative AI semantic conventions — and define the instrumentation contract every agent must implement before it reaches production.
Monitor agent performance in production: task completion, answer quality and groundedness from online evaluation, tool-call and MCP success rates, latency, token use and cost per task, guardrail interventions, and drift or regression against each version's baseline — with SLOs and error budgets set per agent and per risk tier.
Map agent performance across the estate: an authoritative agent registry linking each agent to its owner, versions, tools, MCP servers, models, data sources and risk tier; dependency maps that show blast radius; and performance scorecards that let consumers and governance compare agents and act on the weakest.
Agentify reliability checks: design and deploy operations agents that run health checks, synthetic probes, anomaly triage, evidence gathering and first-line remediation, with defined autonomy limits, human approval for consequential actions and complete audit trails — reducing manual toil and time to detect.
Build the runtime control plane that influences the platform while it runs — kill switches at agent, tool, MCP server, model and platform level; circuit breakers, rate limits, budget caps, throttling and quarantine; and policy enforcement at the gateway — validated under GxP-compliant change control with Quality and Compliance and ISRM, tested regularly, and with every control action recorded as inspection-ready evidence.
Own agent lifecycle management at runtime: registration and admission, runtime readiness gates, promotion between environments, versioning, canary and shadow releases, automated rollback on regression, suspension, deprecation and retirement — so no agent runs in production without an owner, a version and an off switch.
Lead the GenAI platform support team for reliability: L1 and L2 intake, triage runbooks, routing and escalation to L3 engineering, response and resolution commitments, knowledge articles and known-error records — feeding recurring issues back to engineering and documentation, SDK and onboarding gaps to the team that owns the developer-facing surface.
Lead the incident management team: major incident command, severity classification, bridge coordination, stakeholder communication and restoration, using the runtime control plane to contain agent incidents; and chair blameless reviews and problem management until recurring failure modes are engineered out, with corrective actions owned and closed.
Lead, hire, coach and develop the support, incident management and reliability engineers in an inclusive, Credo-grounded environment — with an equitable, sustainable on-call rotation — and manage the cloud, observability and agent operations vendors and the managed service provider for L1 support.

Qualifications:

Minimum of 10 years of progressive technology experience, including at least 5 years in enterprise-scale services, and 3 years of formal people leadership managing engineering, operations or support teams.
Minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related technical discipline; Master's degree preferred.
Demonstrated experience defining and technically delivering an operations, reliability or observability strategy and roadmap for a platform serving multiple internal consumer teams.
Track record of designing and building observability platforms — tracing, metrics, logs, alerting and service health reporting — and using that data to drive engineering prioritization.
Practical experience operating AI, machine learning or LLM-based services in production, including monitoring their quality and performance, not only their availability.
Experience building runtime controls for production systems, such as feature flags, circuit breakers, rate limiting, traffic management, emergency stop or automated rollback.
Hands-on operational experience with workloads running on Microsoft Azure and/or AWS, including containerized services and managed data and networking services.
Experience operating technology in a regulated environment, with working knowledge of GxP change control, computer system validation, and the evidence expected in internal audits or health authority inspections.
Experience automating operational work at scale, including health checks, triage and auto-remediation, and reducing toil through engineering.

Willingness to participate in an escalation rotation supporting a 24x7 platform, including runtime control decisions, and to coordinate across global time zones during major incidents.

We are looking for a hands-on storage system engineer who can turn demanding AI workloads into reliable, scalable infrastructure. The work spans software development,
performance analysis, automation, and production ownership.

What you'll do

· Build and operate distributed file and object storage for AI training: shared researcher filesystems, training datasets, and model checkpoints.

· Automate the storage lifecycle (provisioning, scaling, upgrades, recovery) using Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code.

· Keep it reliable through observability, alerting, testing, safe rollouts, and incident response, partnering with research, security, and storage-provider teams.

Must-haves

· Built or operated production distributed storage, high-performance filesystems, or largescale data infrastructure.
· Strong Linux skills, and can debug filesystem, network, and concurrency issues in production.
· Writes maintainable software or automation in a language such as Python, Go, C++, or Rust.
· Has owned a reliability or performance improvement end to end, from spotting the problem through deployment and verification.

Nice to have

· Experience with cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, or a comparable large-scale orchestration environment.
· Depth in NFS/POSIX and distributed-filesystem internals: metadata, caching, consistency, availability, and recovery.
· Hands-on with one or more distributed or network storage systems such as Hammerspace, Lustre, ZFS/OpenZFS, VAST, or Pure Storage. Depth in comparable systems counts; you do not need every product named here.
· AI or HPC storage patterns: high-throughput data loading, checkpoint writes and restores, metadata-heavy access, and staging data for accelerator clusters.
· Infrastructure-as-code and observability tooling (Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes operators; metrics, tracing, benchmarking), and object/S3 storage with tiering and cross-region movement.

added.description:
About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About This Role

Faire leverages the power of machine learning and data insights to revolutionize the wholesale industry, enabling local retailers to compete against giants like Amazon and big box stores. Our highly skilled team of Applied AI/ML Scientists specialize in developing algorithmic solutions for notification and recommender systems, advertising attribution, and LTV predictions. We are dedicated to building machine learning models that help our customers thrive.

As a Senior Applied AI/ML Scientist on the Retailer Growth team, you will own the modeling and measurement for problems that shape the retailer experience after signup: helping new retailers get started on Faire, and helping retailers build relationships with more brands over time. Because our users are businesses, there is a wealth of information about them that ML models can use to personalize their experience, grow their success, and prioritize where we invest. The team tackles a diverse set of challenges, such as personalizing onboarding for new retailers, deciding which messages to send and when, and finding the moments that turn a first order with a brand into a lasting relationship. You will work across structured and unstructured data using methods that range from predictive modeling and recommendations to information extraction.

Our team already includes experienced Applied AI/ML Scientists from Uber, Airbnb, Square, Facebook, and Pinterest. Faire will soon be known as a top destination for data scientists and machine learning engineers, and you will help take us there!

What You’ll Do

Own applied ML projects end-to-end: framing the problem, building and shipping the model, and measuring impact.
Personalize onboarding and the new retailer experience using what we know about each retailer's business.
Use LLMs to turn unstructured data into signals that improve models and personalization.
Predict retailer activation, churn, and growth potential to prioritize where we invest.
Surface the right brands at the right moments to turn first orders into lasting relationships.
Optimize notifications and brand-to-retailer messaging to drive long-term engagement.
Use experimentation and causal inference to measure the impact of growth levers, including leading indicators for long-term outcomes like retailer lifetime value.
Partner across product, engineering, design, marketing, sales, and analytics to turn models into shipped product and business impact.
Solve challenging problems related to a two-sided marketplace.

Qualifications

3+ years of industry experience building and productionizing machine learning models to solve real-world problems (e.g. Sklearn, XGBoost, deep learning)
Experience with relevant business problems (e-commerce)
Experience with relevant technical methods (predictive modeling, recommendations and personalization, experimentation and causal inference, LLMs)
Strong programming skills (Python, SQL)
An excitement and willingness to learn new tools and techniques
The ability to independently design and implement ML solutions
Strong communication skills and the ability to work in a highly cross-functional team

Great to Haves

Highly recommended: Masters or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, or related STEM fields.
Previous experience in marketplace growth, personalization, recommendations, or notification and messaging systems for a two-sided platform.

Salary Range

San Francisco: the pay range for this role is $211,000 to $290,500 per year.

This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday). Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.

Flexible paid time off, plus company-wide recharge days
Paid parental leave up to 16 weeks
Comprehensive health coverage, with options varying by location
Fertility and family-building benefits through Carrot, including a lifetime reimbursement allowance
Mental health support and coaching through Modern Health
Stipends to support your professional development, wellness, and work from home needs

Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. added.description:
Serve as an experienced individual contributor responsible for framing business problems as analytical, statistical, predictive, and optimization solutions; developing and validating models; and partnering with engineering teams to move approved models into governed production use. Use Python, SQL, Snowflake, Azure, and appropriate modeling methods to create explainable, reproducible, and measurable solutions while applying responsible AI, data governance, privacy, security, and MLOps standards throughout the model lifecycle.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

Partner with business owners, analysts, and subject-matter experts to translate operational problems into testable hypotheses, objective functions, constraints, target variables, evaluation criteria, and measurable business outcomes.
Explore and profile enterprise data; identify data limitations, bias, leakage, missingness, quality concerns, and suitability for statistical, predictive, optimization, or AI/ML methods.
Design and develop statistical analyses, forecasting models, predictive models, machine-learning solutions, and mathematical optimization approaches appropriate to the business problem.
Perform feature engineering in partnership with data engineers and analytics engineers, using governed and reproducible data inputs rather than unmanaged one-off datasets.
Build baselines, select methods, conduct experiments, tune models, and evaluate results using appropriate holdout, cross-validation, back-testing, scenario, sensitivity, and error-analysis techniques.
Document model assumptions, intended use, limitations, training data, features, evaluation results, fairness or risk considerations, explainability, thresholds, and human-oversight requirements.
Validate model outputs with business SMEs, compare recommendations with historical and scenario-based outcomes, and incorporate approved feedback without obscuring model limitations.
Collaborate with data engineering and MLOps resources to package, register, deploy, monitor, retrain, version, and retire models through controlled environments and release processes.
Define and monitor model-performance, drift, data-quality, business-outcome, and operational metrics; investigate degradation and recommend corrective action.
Create clear visualizations, analytical narratives, model cards, experiment records, and decision-support materials for technical and nontechnical audiences.
Apply enterprise AI governance, responsible AI, privacy, security, architecture, SDLC, and regulatory requirements; surface residual risks and obtain required approvals before production use.
Advance reusable modeling practices, peer review, testing standards, and knowledge sharing across the team; provide technical guidance on complex analytical work.
The requirements herein describe the general nature and level of work performed by the employee but are not a complete list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Other duties may be assigned as needed.

,

Minimum Requirements

Education and Experience

Undergraduate degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field; graduate degree preferred for roles with advanced optimization or research responsibilities.
6+ years of experience in data science, applied statistics, operations research, machine learning, optimization, or a related quantitative discipline.
Advanced proficiency with Python and SQL and experience using common data-science, statistics, machine-learning, and optimization libraries.
Experience developing models using Snowflake or comparable cloud data platforms and working with Azure-based data, application, or ML services.
Experience with problem formulation, feature engineering, experiment design, model selection, model evaluation, explainability, and communication of uncertainty and limitations.
Experience moving models beyond notebooks into versioned, testable, monitored, and supportable production workflows in partnership with engineering teams.
Experience with forecasting, predictive modeling, mathematical optimization, or decision science; operations research and constraint-based optimization experience strongly preferred when supporting planning and scheduling use cases.
Knowledge of responsible AI, model risk, data privacy, security, governance, and documentation practices.
Relevant Azure, Snowflake, data science, ML, or analytics certification preferred.

Deep knowledge of statistical reasoning, machine learning, model evaluation, experimentation, and the appropriate use and limitations of quantitative methods.
Able to frame ambiguous business problems, distinguish predictive questions from optimization or rules-based problems, and select methods based on evidence rather than novelty.
Able to evaluate model performance using technically sound and business-relevant measures and clearly explain tradeoffs, uncertainty, limitations, and residual risk.
Strong Python, SQL, data exploration, feature engineering, visualization, and reproducible research skills.
Strong understanding of data leakage, bias, drift, explainability, human oversight, privacy, security, responsible AI, and model governance.
Able to collaborate with data engineers, analytics engineers, MLOps engineers, application teams, analysts, product owners, and business SMEs across the full model lifecycle.

Able to balance model accuracy with interpretability, operational constraints, reliability, cost, maintainability, and business adoption.

Job Summary

In your pivotal role of Data Scientist 2, you will make big-data discoveries, build the resources necessary to enable those discoveries, and coordinate data-related activities of the project team(s). Work closely with research informatics faculty and staff to expand and create innovative big data resources to enable data-driven translational science. Identify appropriate resources needed and develop schedules to ensure timely completion of project(s). Find insights into data, as well as solve related medium to complex problems.

This role supports the All of Us (AoU) Research Program, a groundbreaking national initiative funded by the National Institutes of Health (NIH) that aims to accelerate medical research by building one of the most diverse health databases in history. For more information about VICTR’s role supporting the All of Us Research Program, please see information about the All of Us Data and Research Center: https://researchallofus.org/.

This position works normal business hours Monday – Friday and offers the opportunity to work remotely.

About the Department:

The Vanderbilt Institute for Clinical & Translational Research (VICTR) is Vanderbilt’s virtual home for clinical and translational research. Supported by Vanderbilt University Medical Center’s Office of Research and the NIH-sponsored Clinical and Translational Service Award (CTSA), the mission of the institute is to transform the way ideas and research discoveries make their way from origin to patient care. VICTR functions to help researchers and clinicians do their jobs better by providing tools and support to improve the quality of research, publications, grant writing, and training for future doctors and researchers. For more information, please visit https://victr.vumc.org/.

Key Responsibilities

Build a solid data foundation in order to perform robust analytics.
Participate in multidisciplinary teams to design, develop, and recommend new approaches for data-driven decision-making.
Guide and educate data science teams to provide unbiased and accurate information, analysis, consultation, and recommendations to support strategic and operational data science initiatives.
Make strategic recommendations on data collection, integration and retention requirements, incorporating business requirements and knowledge of best practices.
Build machine learning pipelines and personalized data products.
Advise leadership on implications of the data for products, processes and decisions.
Develop and implement reproducible cross-validation frameworks to evaluate machine learning and artificial intelligence models across heterogeneous datasets and computing environments

Technical Capabilities

INFRASTRUCTURE (INTERMEDIATE)

Identify the data-analytics problems that offer the greatest opportunities. Determine the correct data sets and variables. Collect large sets of structured and unstructured data from disparate sources. Clean and validate the data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and uniformity. Devise and applies models and algorithms to mine the stores of big data. Analyze the data to identify patterns and trends. Interpret the data to discover solutions and opportunities.

ANALYSIS AND TESTING (INTERMEDIATE)

Bring structure to large quantities of formless data and make analysis possible. Identify rich data sources, join them with other, potentially incomplete data sources, clean the resulting set and validate the data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and uniformity. Identify trends, correlations, and high-level characteristics to detect key insights and make predictions. Find a story within a data set and provide a coherent narrative about key data insights.

DATA PRODUCTS (INTERMEDIATE)

Use machine learning and artificial intelligence to turn massive data streams produced by operations into insights. Use programming languages such as Python, R, SQL, and Jupyter for statistics, mathematics, algorithms, modeling, data visualization, and reproducible research and reporting. Use cloud computing, cloud-based services and APIs for data storage and access, machine learning, and artificial intelligence (AI).

COMMUNICATION (NOVICE)

Deliver data to internal and external customers in the form of dashboards, reports, and emails. Effectively communicate technical and business ideas and information to others, including non-technical audiences in writing, with numbers, verbally and/or visually. Share knowledge, ideas and information openly, and effectively sell new ideas and influence others.

BASIC QUALIFICIATIONS

Master’s Degree in mathematics or statistics (or equivalent experience) (Required)
5 years of relevant experience (Required)
PhD with 3 years of relevant experience

World-leading academic departments and comprehensive centers of excellence pursue scientific discoveries and transformational educational and clinical advances across the entire spectrum of health and disease.

About Us

Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. Founded in 2017, product launched in 2019, and achieved profitability in 2024.

Why We Exist

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).

Why We’re Hiring

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

As Our Business Continues To Expand, There Is Growing Demand For More Data Science Team Members. We Are Hiring 2-3 People To Drive Impact In These Areas

Growth Marketing
Product Development
Strategic Partnerships

On leveling:
You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.
No corporate fluff: The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals.
Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end.

What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Data Science & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.
Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.
Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

Who You Are

First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"
Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.
Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

What You'll Bring

1+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.
Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.
Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.
Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

Our Tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

About Us

Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. Founded in 2017, product launched in 2019, and achieved profitability in 2024.

Why We Exist

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).

Why We’re Hiring

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

As Our Business Continues To Expand, There Is Growing Demand For More Data Science Team Members. We Are Hiring 2-3 People To Drive Impact In These Areas

Growth Marketing
Product Development
Strategic Partnerships

On leveling:
You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.
No corporate fluff: The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals.
Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end.

What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Data Science & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.
Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.
Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

Who You Are

First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"
Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.
Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

What You'll Bring

2+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.
Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.
Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.
Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

Our Tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

As a Senior Associate or Principal at Flagship Pioneering, you will be the protagonist entrepreneur behind a new company built on a pioneering scientific platform. Flagship Pioneering (“FSP”) conceives and develops first-in-category bioplatform companies to transform human health and sustainability. FSP has developed over 100 scientific ventures, resulting in more than $130 billion in aggregate value. FSP seeks to change the world by addressing some of humanity’s most urgent challenges: curing intractable diseases, improving human health, and feeding the world by advancing the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture.

Act as primary owner and driver of the company through each phase: exploration, ProtoCo, NewCo and into growth

Set IP strategy for the technology and company, write seminal patent applications, and assess the IP landscape, including key competitors
Develop the corporate strategy and operations plan: define value creation, prioritize the application spaces where the platform has an advantage, set goals and resourcing, and prepare for financing
Build relationships with academic leaders, industry and technology partners, and thought experts to validate and de-risk venture concepts, and develop audience-specific pitches that support business development and financingRecruit and manage the early scientific and computational team, advisors and CROs, set up lab facilities and early operations, and partner with Flagship operations teams and Pioneering Intelligence
Become the institutional subject matter expert and transfer that knowledge to the active company team. Stay current on literature, conferences, funding opportunities and new developments in AI/ML and chemistry

WHO THRIVES IN THIS ROLE

You are a scientist-entrepreneur who has helped start something: a member of a founding team at the Senior Associate level, a founder at the Principal level. You bring technical grounding in biomolecule design, chemistry and/or engineering, and the range to solve problems across disciplines as a generalist. You have fluency in AI/ML as applied to biotech to hold a point of view and engage computational scientists in depth. You are comfortable driving wet lab work, operating in ambiguity, and originating first-in-category companies through the Flagship model.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

The ideal candidate has a STEM-based PhD or MD from a top university and a technical background in biomolecule design, chemistry and/or engineering that equips them to solve problems across disciplines. Range, judgment and speed of learning count as much as depth in any single field. The candidate must have a passion for novel science and be operationally savvy.

Principal:
8 + years of experience, including founding or co-founding a company, platform or major scientific program. Primary owner of a pioneering scientific endeavor, with a track record of conceiving new science that formed the basis of a platform, and a demonstrated ability to build and lead teams and work with senior executives, boards and investors.

Senior Associate:
4 + years of experience in life sciences biotech, start-up or entrepreneurial activities, including as a member of a founding team with ownership of scientific or technical strategy and execution.

Important skills and capabilities include:

Proven ability to rapidly become conversant in new areas of science and engage thought leaders at the deepest technical level
Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information and communicate a clear, compelling value proposition for a scientific opportunity to technical and non-technical audiences
Working knowledge of multiple therapeutic modalities of drug discovery
Working fluency in AI/ML as applied to biotech: able to engage computational scientists at depth, navigate the model landscape to identify venture opportunities, and hold a clear point of view on how AI/ML will change the design and execution of scientific platforms and the future of biotech and company origination
Open, transparent communication, a passion for growth, willingness to engage in difficult conversations professionally, and a track record of giving, receiving and acting on feedback
Ability to work effectively in teams, lead and manage, and operate in an entrepreneurial environment with a sense of urgency

More About Flagship Pioneering:

Flagship Pioneering is a scientific innovation engine that invents and builds companies that change the world. We bring together the greatest scientific minds with entrepreneurial company builders and assemble the capital to allow them to take courageous leaps in human health, sustainability, and beyond. 

What sets Flagship apart is our ability to advance biotechnology by uniting life science innovation, company creation, and capital investment under one roof in a way that is largely without precedent. Our team of scientists, entrepreneurial leaders, and professional capital managers are each aligned around an institutionalized process that enables us to innovate and create breakthroughs for the benefit of people and planet.

Many of the companies Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture.

Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies, and has been named four times to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies.

Flagship Pioneering and our ecosystem companies are committed to equal employment opportunity
regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

At Flagship, we recognize there is no perfect candidate. If you have some of the experience listed above but not all, please apply anyway. Experience comes in many forms, skills are transferable, and passion goes a long way. We are dedicated to building diverse and inclusive teams and look forward to learning more about your unique background.

added.title: Data Science Associate
added.description:
About Onyx.

Onyx is building a social trading platform for what happens next. We started in sports and grew to more than one million users. Now, through Onyx Predictions, users can trade on the outcomes of real-world events. We’ve also launched Pack Rips for trading cards, with crypto perpetuals up next.

Onyx Predictions is a CFTC-registered introducing broker and NFA member. Our exclusive clearing agreement with Payward Services Derivatives gives us the infrastructure to expand into new markets. Payward, the parent company of Kraken, also led our $20 million Series A at a $220 million valuation, less than a year after we came out of beta.

We’re a small team building in New York, with people from Jane Street, DraftKings, Robinhood, xAI, SIG, HRT, and Harvard. You’ll build for an audience that’s already here and help take new products from idea to launch.

The Role.

We’re hiring a Data Scientist to help teams across Onyx make better decisions with data. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Finance, and Trading to understand user behavior, measure product changes, identify opportunities, and influence what we build next.

You’ll combine strong analytical skills with business judgment. You’ll take projects from the initial question through analysis and recommendations, and build the metrics and tools that help teams answer important questions themselves.

What You’ll Own

Partner with teams to define success metrics, evaluate performance, and identify opportunities.
Design and analyze experiments, including tests of product changes, customer journeys, and growth initiatives.
Investigate user behavior across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and monetization.
Build analytical frameworks, models, and forecasts to inform product and business decisions.
Develop datasets, dashboards, and tools that make reliable data easier to access and use.
Own data projects end to end, from scoping the question to communicating findings and recommendations.
Help improve event tracking, data quality, and the reliability of core metrics.
Explain results clearly, including uncertainty and limitations, to both technical and nontechnical partners.
Work with Engineering to make data collection and analysis more dependable as the product grows.

You’ll Do Well Here If You

Have 4+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related role.
Are fluent in SQL and proficient in Python or R.
Have a strong foundation in statistics, experimentation, and/or forecasting.
Have worked with large datasets and distributed data systems.
Can turn ambiguous questions into rigorous analysis and practical recommendations.
Communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical partners.
Have supported product, growth, finance, platform, or internal tooling teams.
Take ownership and can deliver useful work in a fast-moving environment.

Even Better If You Have

Experience at a consumer product, fintech, trading, crypto, sports, or prediction markets company.
Familiarity with event-based products, marketplaces, or financial transactions.
Built data tools, reusable datasets, or self-serve analytics workflows.
Experience improving experimentation practices or product instrumentation.

Location:

This role is based in our NoHo, Manhattan office, with core in-office days Tuesday through Thursday.
Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. Onyx is unable to provide employment sponsorship for this position.

Compensation And Benefits

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $150,000–$200,000, depending on experience, impact, and scope, plus target bonus and equity.

Benefits Include

Fully covered medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Meaningful equity ownership.
Commuter benefits.

Why Onyx?

Onyx is for people with conviction.

We hire talented people and give them real ownership. Our teams are small, the work is visible, and good ideas go from discussion to production quickly.

We move fast because our markets do. We value judgment, initiative, and the quality of what you ship. Anyone can bring an idea. If you make the call, you own the outcome.

We’re ambitious without ego. We debate openly, make decisions with imperfect information, and follow through.

Come build what’s next with us.

added.description:
About us

Every day we deliver safe and secure energy to homes, communities, and businesses. We are there when people need us the most. We connect people to the energy they need for the lives they live. The pace of change in society and our industry is accelerating, and our expertise and track record puts us in an unparalleled position to shape the sustainable future of our industry.
To be successful we must anticipate the needs of our customers, reducing the cost of energy delivery today and pioneering the flexible energy systems of tomorrow. This requires us to deliver on our promises and always look for new opportunities to grow, both ourselves and our business.
National Grid is hiring a Senior Data Scientist, Data Management & Analytics - Load Forecasting & Analytics. This position can be based out of Waltham, MA; Hicksville, NY; Brooklyn, NY; or Syracuse, NY. This is a hybrid role.
Employees are expected to work from their assigned office or another approved work location outside the home at least three days per week. Additional in-person attendance may be required based on role, team, and business needs.
Job Purpose

The Load Forecasting & Analytics (LFA) team produces electric and gas load forecasts for National Grid. As a Senior Data Scientist in the Data Management & Analytics (DMA) team within LFA, you will support the development, presentation, and regulatory defense of the long- and short-term electric and gas load forecasts.
Responsibilities include data pipeline development and maintenance; cloud data platform management; data science enablement and automation; and collaboration with technical and business stakeholders.
Key Accountabilities

Design and implement ETL/ELT processes to collect, transform, and store data from various data sources (databases, APIs, FTPs) using a range of technologies depending upon the use case (Azure, SQL, Python)
Assemble small and large individual data sets that meet internal business requirements and are within the overall LFA technology platform
Develop, manage, and maintain the LFA technology platform, which includes cloud computing assets, database architecture, stored procedures and orchestration jobs, and reporting
Drive the process to automate manual procedures and optimize data delivery for forecasters and end users
Assist with research, implementation, and delivery of data products that directly support forecast development which meets regulatory requirements such as the Massachusetts Electric Sector Modernization Plan, the New York Climate Plan, and Distributed System Implementation Plan
Work with forecasters and stakeholders to assist with data-related technical issues and to support their ongoing data and technology needs

Qualifications

Quantitative fields
include computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, information systems, or closely related disciplines. Relevant experience includes data science, data engineering, data analytics. Education and professional experience meeting one of the following:
Master's degree in quantitative field + 2 years of relevant experience,
Bachelor's degree in quantitative field + 3 years of relevant experience,
or Bachelor's degree in non-quantitative field + 5 years of relevant experience
Experience working with relational databases and cloud data warehouses including data modelling and performance optimization. Experience with Snowflake preferred, but relevant experience with other tools helpful (SQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL,etc.)
Strong proficiency in SQL and Python including developing data transformations, analytical workflows, and automated processes
Knowledge in developing, maintaining, and orchestrating data pipelines, including data ingestion and transformation. Experience with Airflow and dbt preferred
Exposure to modern data platforms and development practices including version control, automated deployments, and CI/CD workflows. Git, Azure, Terraform, GitHub Actions experience preferred
Experience working in a Hybrid-Cloud environment, including deploying, managing, and connecting cloud-based services. Experience in Linux and bash are helpful.
Proficiency in integrating, cleaning, and transforming data from disparate sources into reliable customer facing datasets
Excellent communication skills including the ability to explain technical concepts and analytics findings to non-technical stakeholders
Ability to design and develop scalable, reusable, and maintainable data solutions supporting multiple projects and multiple stakeholders
Relevant energy industry experience or experience in a regulated setting preferred

More Information

MA Salary: $133,000 - $156,000 a year

added.description:
Company Overview

Planview has one mission: to close the gap between strategic intent and business outcome, providing the intelligence organizations need to act decisively.

As the global leader in Strategic Portfolio Management, Planview helps organizations of all sizes achieve their business goals, faster and smarter. Our comprehensive platform bring initiatives, investments, and resources into a continuous, connected model of the business: the actionable understanding leaders need to move decisively, keep teams and AI in lockstep, and know how their initiatives are performing.—now powered by Planview Anvi, our next-generation enterprise AI that delivers expert guidance, intelligent recommendations, and actionable insights, turning complex data into decisive action from strategy through execution.

Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Strategic Portfolio Management for the fifth consecutive year, we proudly serve more than 3,000 customers globally, including 45% of the Fortune 100—and more than 3 million users worldwide.

Why Join Planview?

At Planview, our people’s connections drive our innovation and success. Our global team of 1,500+ employees work remotely and across offices in Austin, Vancouver, Hod HaSharon, Bangalore, Sydney, and Stockholm. We've built a world-class, connected culture rooted in shared values that empowers our teams to thrive and succeed from anywhere. When you join Planview, you're not just joining a company, you're joining a movement to transform how the world works.

Discover more about our portfolio at planview.com, and connect with us on LinkedIn, Instagram, and X.

The Opportunity

Join our team as a Sr. Data Scientist in Austin, TX. This position will help integrate data science, optimization, and simulation capabilities within Planview's planning solutions. You will contribute

to data collection and analysis, build predictive models, and work with

Generative AI technologies including Planview Anvi.

What You'll Do

Optimization: Formulate and solve optimization problems for portfolio prioritization, investment and resource allocation, and capacity planning to maximize strategic value under constraints.
Simulation: Build simulation models (e.g., Monte Carlo, discrete-event) to stress-test portfolio plans, quantify risk and uncertainty, and forecast outcomes across scenarios.
Predictive Modeling: Build, test, and refine models to predict delivery timelines, portfolio outcomes, and investment performance.
Agentic AI: Design MCP (Model Context Protocol) interfaces that expose optimization, simulation, and predictive capabilities to Planview Anvi and other AI agents.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications:

Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field. (PhD a plus)
5+ years of experience building and deploying data science, optimization, or simulation solutions.
Proficiency in Python and SQL, along with familiarity with libraries such as pandas and scikit-learn.
Experience with optimization and/or simulation methods (e.g., linear/integer programming, heuristics, Monte Carlo, discrete-event simulation).
Demonstrated experience in translating customer challenges into data- driven product enhancements.
Strong knowledge of machine learning algorithms and statistical methodologies.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and mentor others.\
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

Familiarity with portfolio management and planning frameworks (e.g., SAFe, Lean Portfolio Management, Agile, Waterfall).
Hands-on experience with AWS services such as Athena, SageMaker, Lambda, and Bedrock.
Experience with optimization solvers or simulation libraries.
Experience building with Large Language Models and agent frameworks, including exposure to the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Understanding of knowledge graphs and ontologies.

Benefits At Planview

At Planview, you’ll join our global team and culture which reflects the vibrant communities in which our employees live and work. To support you at Planview, you will enjoy:

Unplugged Days: 4 company-wide paid days off per year to recharge and relax.
Generous PTO offerings (region dependent).
Region specific competitive benefit plans to support you at any life stage including parental leave, retirement, medical plans, wellness support, and remote work support.
Paid time to volunteer through Planview’s Force for Good Week.
Employee Referral bonus program.
Weekly office lunches for hybrid team members and social events.
Flexible work hours/environment.

Now is a great time to join our team. If you are looking for a place to grow your career, innovate with best-in-class solutions, and build the future of connected work, Planview is the right place for you!

Equal Employment Opportunity at Planview

Planview is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. As part of our efforts to build a diverse workforce, we encourage applications from Indigenous, Black, and other racialized communities, 2SLGBTQIA+ communities, people with neurodivergence, immigrants, people with disabilities, and other equity deserving groups. In addition to building a diverse workforce, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible experience.

The base compensation range for the role in any of those locations is $104,900 USD - $194,700 USD. For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the base compensation range for this role is $91,000 USD - $169,000 USD. For Ontario, Canada, the base compensation range for this role is $93,000 CAD - $143,000 CAD. Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs. This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. added.title: Sr. Applied Scientist, Amazon Leo, Amazon Leo Networking Software
added.description:
Description

Amazon Leo is building a low Earth orbit satellite broadband network to bring fast, affordable connectivity to customers worldwide. We're looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to invent the machine learning that will let the network predict, explain and prevent its own failures.

You'll work on open research problems at large scale. These include anomaly detection on non-stationary, high-dimensional telemetry, causal root-cause inference over constantly changing satellite and ground network graphs, and trustworthy ML for operators making decisions under pressure. You'll own the science agenda, from forming hypotheses and designing new models to putting them into production systems that protect customer connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities

Define and lead a multi-year applied research agenda in network observability, anomaly prediction and availability modeling.

Invent new time-series and spatio-temporal graph models, such as graph neural networks (GNNs), foundation models and dynamic baselining, to predict network and ground-segment failures before customers are affected.

Develop causal inference and causal discovery methods for automated root-cause attribution across a large, interdependent event surface.

Research probabilistic models that break availability and throughput into causal drivers (coverage, ground, network, terminal, payload, planning) and separate true signal from noise.

Advance methods for alert correlation, deduplication, uncertainty quantification and metric-quality scoring.

Explore large language models (LLMs) and agentic approaches for reasoning over telemetry, logs and incident narratives.

Design rigorous offline and online evaluation, including backtesting against real closed incidents and gameday-based benchmarks.

Take research into production on AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock), working with engineers on scalability, drift detection and explainability.

Publish at top-tier venues, file patents and raise the scientific bar through mentoring and design reviews.

A day in the life

You might start the morning reading new literature on causal discovery and sketching how it applies to Leo's network graph. Later you could review a scientist's experiment design and debate the best evaluation methodology. During an event, you would test your attribution model live on the incident call. You might finish the day prototyping a new spatio-temporal anomaly detector and backtesting it against last quarter's incidents.

About The Team

Amazon Leo Networking Software builds the software behind Leo's satellite and ground network. Our applied science team works on hard, open-ended problems with real-world impact. We value scientific rigor, curiosity and ownership, and we encourage publishing and contributing to the research community. As a Senior Applied Scientist, you'll help build this science function from the ground up and set the technical bar for the scientists who join after you.

Basic Qualifications

PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.
