added.title: Research Engineer, AI Risk Modeling
added.description:
The Institute for Security and Technology (IST), a 501(c)(3) critical action think tank that unites technology and policy leaders to create solutions to emerging security challenges, is seeking a Research Engineer, AI Risk Modeling to join its AI Center.

This role bridges the gap between abstract AI risk concepts and actionable, empirically grounded decision-making tools for frontier labs, evaluators, and policymakers. Working closely with the AI Center team, the Research Engineer will design statistical models, measurement frameworks, and evaluation protocols that characterize risk dynamics and capability thresholds across AI systems. Success looks like producing modular, well-documented methodologies that generalize across organizational contexts and are actively referenced in lab piloting, policy development, and cross-industry adoption, particularly in support of IST's Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) risk thresholds initiative and broader AI risk modeling portfolio.

IST takes collaborative action to advance national security and global stability through trustworthy technology, guiding businesses and governments with hands-on expertise, in-depth analysis, and a global network. Since its foundation in 2020, IST has launched a vast array of impactful initiatives addressing challenges such as ransomware, the resilience of lifeline critical infrastructure, trust and safety, nuclear risk reduction, the role of artificial intelligence, and more.

Key Responsibilities

The Research Engineer, AI Risk Modeling will report to the Director for AI Security Research and will perform the following functions: 

Contribute quantitative expertise to design research methodologies for AI risk modeling projects, including causal inference, Bayesian methods, and longitudinal analysis
Develop and validate statistical models that characterize risk dynamics, intervention effectiveness, and capability thresholds across AI systems
Design and implement technical measurement frameworks and data collection pipelines that support empirical risk assessment (e.g., structured logging schemas, experimental harnesses, uncertainty quantification)
Support the development of evaluation protocols and testing methodologies that generalize across models, tasks, and organizational contexts
Assist in translating technical findings into modular frameworks suitable for lab piloting, policy reference, and cross-organizational adoption
Document methodology and findings clearly and legibly for both technical and policy audiences, with explicit separation of empirical claims from normative judgments
Collaborate with the larger AI Center team on a portfolio of AI security and safety projects, adapting risk modeling methods to diverse problem structures
Collaborate with lab safety teams and external reviewers to refine measurement approaches and align evaluation protocols across organizational boundaries

Qualifications

Requirements

Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in Mathematics, Statistics, Quantitative Methods, Computer Science, or Machine Learning, or equivalent experience; candidates from AI safety backgrounds with demonstrated quantitative depth will also be considered
2–4 years of experience in research design, statistical modeling, or quantitative analysis
Strong proficiency in at least one statistical programming language (e.g., Python, R, Julia) and experience with probabilistic modeling frameworks
Experience with Bayesian methods, time-series analysis, and dynamic modeling approaches
Demonstrated ability to design rigorous experiments or observational studies with clear causal identification strategies
Ability to work independently and communicate technical concepts to mixed technical/policy audiences
As required by the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986 (IRCA), IST only employs persons legally eligible to work in the US. New employees must complete an I-9 Form and provide actual documents verifying their identity and eligibility to work in the US within three (3) business days of the date of hire. IST participates in the E-Verify program to electronically verify employment eligibility.
Must be legally able to work in the United States without sponsorship.
This position is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check

Preferred 

Prior experience in AI safety (e.g., AI labs or governance research organizations)
Proficiency with AI/ML systems, safety evaluation, or risk assessment frameworks
Prior work on empirical safety research, red-teaming, adversarial testing, or benchmarking
Peer-reviewed publications or demonstrated work in quantitative risk modeling, safety engineering, or related areas
Experience engaging with technical stakeholders in industry, government, or academia
Familiarity with policy processes and government AI evaluation bodies

Compensation and benefits
This is a full-time employee position with an expected start date of January 4, 2027, or as mutually agreed. The expected annual base salary range for this role is $140,000 – $185,000, depending on experience and qualifications.
IST’s generous compensation package consists of three core elements: base salary, benefits, and the potential for bonuses. We are committed to pay fairness and aim for these three elements collectively to be highly competitive with market rates in the non-profit sector. Benefits we offer include:

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance for you and all your dependents.
401(k) plan with up to 4% matching.
12 weeks paid parental leave.
Unlimited PTO after the introductory period. Most staff take between 3-4 weeks each year, sometimes more!
Potential stipends for education, home office, commuting, and wellness.
Potential for partial relocation support for those moving to the Bay Area.

Compensation is dependent on experience and is based on IST’s good faith estimate for this position, as of the date of publication and may be modified in the future. The level of pay, exact job title and role will depend on a variety of job-related factors, including where you place on our internal performance ladders, which is based on factors including past work experience, relevant education, and performance on our interviews or in a work trial.

Location

This is a remote position. Preference will be given to candidates located in the San Francisco Bay Area. Given the need for real-time collaboration with the AI Center team, the employee is expected to generally be reachable during standard Pacific Time business hours, while retaining flexibility over their daily schedule.

How to apply
Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We anticipate this posting closing on January 4, 2027, or once the position is filled, whichever comes first. The deadline may be extended if needed.

For more information, visit www.securityandtechnology.org . If you're ready to embark on an exhilarating journey at the forefront of AI security policy, then seize this opportunity to join us at IST. added.description:
Description

Do you like helping U.S. Department of Defense organizations implement innovative cloud computing solutions and solve technical problems? Would you like to do this using the latest cloud computing technologies? Do you have a knack for helping these groups understand application architectures and integration approaches, and do you have the consultative skills to launch a project on a trajectory to success?

Come join our team as a Solutions Architect (SA) and help us accelerate our growing U.S. Defense Department business as part of the World Wide Public Sector practice. This SA will join a team that supports US Navy, Marine Corps, and other Department of War customers. This is an excellent opportunity to join Amazon’s truly innovative technical teams, while also developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies anywhere.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to build broad use of Amazon Web Services (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon S3, Amazon EC2, and AWS Lambda) directly with customers and our ecosystem of system integrators and solution providers. You will leverage generative AI to solve customer challenges and deliver POCs in their environments. Your broad responsibilities will include: owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects; defining implementation architectures, developing a deep expertise in the AWS technologies as well as broad know-how around how applications and services are constructed using the AWS platform; and being a subject matter expert on security and other technologies as it relates to customer applications and services.

You will provide thoughtful technical design and offer sensitivity to our customer needs in the Defense markets for cloud computing working with a truly innovative sales and business development team. You will lead efforts to capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solution architect community. You will have the opportunity to learn from, collaborate with, and educate some of the brightest technical minds in the industry today across the breadth of enterprise architecture.

You should apply to this role if you are passionate about:

Creating, building, educating, training and designing cloud computing architectures, especially if it’s for Defense Department customers.
Getting hands on to experiment, build, and demonstrate technology solutions leveraging the latest AI technologies to expedite delivery and quality.
Deep-dive technical discussions around design and the curiosity to keep your technical skills current while maintaining a pulse on industry trends
Our company credo: “Work hard. Have fun. Make history.” It’s critical to love what you do and take pride in your value proposition to our customers.

Executive Speaking and Presentation Skills – White board, small and large group presentations
Technical – Experience with AI/GenAI, software development, web applications services development/deployment, DevOps/DevSecOps, cloud computing, data and database architectures and analytics, or networking

We are building the future of customer experience at talkdesk, and the Forward Deployed team is a critical group which leads the design and implementation of AI Agent based Automated solutions for many industry verticals. As an AI Deployment Strategist, you operate as a "founding builder" and trusted advisor . Your mission is to understand a customer's business operations from first principles, design custom AI/agentic solutions, and guide customers through the complete transition from experimental AI pilots to durable, production-ready system rollouts .
We are looking for a high-agency individual to join our team as a founding AI Deployment Strategist. Unlike traditional software delivery, deploying generative AI fundamentally mutates operational workflows and alters decision-making rights. Your mission will be to act as a trusted consultant and AI thought leader
for our most strategic customers, understand their business from first principles, and deploy cutting-edge AI agents that deliver undeniable value. You will build and optimize the AI architecture and act as the single-threaded owner of business realization, executive alignment, and change management.
You will operate at the intersection of strategy, sales, consulting, and hands-on engineering. This role requires the ability to lead executive-level workshops, design transformative AI solutions, and then roll up your sleeves to bring them to life. If you thrive in ambiguity, take extreme ownership, and are passionate about building what's next, this is the team for you.
What You'll Do:

Own the AI Lifecycle:

Lead end-to-end customer engagements, from initial discovery and strategic scoping to hands-on deployment, value realization, and executive readout.
Be a Strategic Consultant & Thought Leader:

Act as the primary technical advisor and consultant for our customers. Lead workshops, cut through the industry hype to guide their AI strategy, and build trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders by connecting technical capabilities to tangible business outcomes.
Design & Build AI Agents:

Work directly with customers to design, build, and iteratively refine conversational AI agents or agentic workflows to resolve problems more autonomously
Develop the Playbook:

You are building our deployment motion from the ground up. You will be responsible for creating and refining the playbooks, best practices, and processes that will scale our AI program.
Drive Business Impact:

Identify and prioritize high-impact use cases that generate clear, decision-ready signals tied to business value. Your success is measured by the outcomes you deliver for our customers and the growth you drive for Talkdesk.
Shape the Product:

Act as the voice of the customer, providing a tight feedback loop to our Product and Engineering teams to help shape the future of our AI platform.

What We're Looking For:

3+ years of experience in an AI based forward deployment, customer-facing, technical role such as Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting, Customer Success, or Product Management.
3+ years of software development experience with experience in JavaScript, API integrations, Python and other AI/ML tools. Experience working with Cloud services and stack such as AWS and/Or Azure. 
Consultative AI Expertise: A consultative approach and the ability to act as an AI thought leader—educating customers on market trends, best practices, and the transformative potential of agentic AI.
A proven track record of taking ownership over complex, ambiguous projects and delivering measurable results in a fast-paced environment.
Strong technical aptitude with hands-on experience deploying AI, automation, or enterprise SaaS solutions. Direct experience developing with AI agents, LLMs, and related frameworks is a must.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to command a room, articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and executive audiences, and drive alignment.
A "seller mindset" with commercial instincts; you are comfortable engaging in deal conversations and are motivated by driving customer value and expansion.
High-agency and a "first principles" approach to problem-solving. You can see what needs to be done and have the bias for action to do it without being asked.

5+ Years in Technical consulting experience leading scaled implementations with ability to dive deep and implement technically complex solutions individually. 
Experience in a high-growth startup environment.
Background in product management, conversation design, or a forward-deployed engineering role.
Familiarity with contact center operations or CRM platforms.

added.title: Senior AI Lead
added.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Senior AI Lead
to support Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) modernization initiatives involving artificial intelligence, automation, data, and digital workflow transformation. This full-time role provides senior technical leadership for AI-enabled solutions from discovery and feasibility through prototyping, evaluation, deployment readiness, and iterative improvement. The Senior AI Lead will help ensure AI capabilities are mission-aligned, technically sound, measurable, secure, supportable, and appropriate for the users and workflows they serve.

The Senior AI Lead will translate mission needs into practical solution approaches with emphasis on generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic AI, intelligent automation, and AI-enabled decision support. The role will guide multidisciplinary teams through model and platform selection, data and integration dependencies, prompt and orchestration patterns, evaluation, human oversight, observability, performance, cost, and transition to sustainable operations.

This role is the senior technical point of coordination for AI execution and works closely with software, data, platform/DevSecOps, product/HCD, QA, cybersecurity/privacy, and governance/architecture resources. Strong candidates combine deep AI and cloud fluency with sound engineering judgment, disciplined experimentation, clear communication, and the ability to lead technical teams through ambiguity.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

Serve as the senior technical lead for AI-enabled solution delivery from problem framing and feasibility through prototype, evaluation, deployment readiness, and iterative improvement.
Translate VA mission and workflow needs into AI solution approaches, technical requirements, evaluation criteria, and delivery roadmaps that account for data, security, privacy, user, and operational constraints.
Lead technical design decisions for generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic AI, intelligent automation, AI-assisted decision support, and related AI/ML capabilities.
Guide selection of models, AI services, orchestration frameworks, retrieval approaches, prompt patterns, agent tools, APIs, and cloud services based on mission fit, risk, performance, cost, and maintainability.
Define AI evaluation approaches covering task success, groundedness, relevance, error modes, hallucination risk, latency, cost, safety, human review, and release criteria appropriate to the use case.
Partner with data and domain teams to assess authoritative sources, retrieval quality, data readiness, lineage, access constraints, sensitivity, and fitness for AI-enabled use.
Coordinate technical execution across software development, data, platform/DevSecOps, integration, QA, HCD/product, cybersecurity/privacy, and other disciplines so AI components operate as part of an end-to-end solution.
Establish practical human-in-the-loop, feedback, guardrail, fallback, escalation, and monitoring patterns, especially for consequential operational or clinical-adjacent workflows.
Provide senior review of AI prototypes and implementations, identify material design or engineering risks early, and drive remediation before pilot, release, or scale decisions.
Work with platform and DevSecOps resources on deployment, secrets, logging, observability, versioning, performance, reliability, model/configuration management, and operational support for AI services.
Monitor AI solution economics and advise on model choice, caching, routing, token use, infrastructure, and reuse to improve cost efficiency without compromising mission outcomes.
Communicate technical findings, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations to VA stakeholders and LMI leadership; mentor technical staff and establish reusable AI engineering, evaluation, and documentation practices.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, artificial intelligence, information systems, engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent professional experience may be considered. Advanced degree is valued.
10+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, solution architecture, cloud engineering, data/AI systems, technical delivery, or related disciplines, including responsibility for complex enterprise solutions.
3+ years of recent hands-on or technical-lead experience delivering AI/ML, generative AI, LLM, agentic AI, or AI-enabled automation solutions beyond isolated proofs of concept.
Demonstrated experience translating ambiguous mission or business needs into AI solution approaches, technical architectures, evaluation plans, implementation priorities, and measurable outcomes.
Strong working knowledge of LLM solution patterns including prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings/vector retrieval, tool/function calling, agents/orchestration, model selection, context management, and evaluation.
Hands-on technical fluency with Python, APIs, JSON, SQL/data access, cloud services, source/version control, and modern engineering practices sufficient to review code, troubleshoot integrations, and guide engineers.
Experience leading AI solutions in Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, or comparable enterprise environments, including integration with data services, identity/access controls, APIs, logging, monitoring, and deployment pipelines.
Experience establishing AI evaluation and quality practices using test datasets, task-based evaluation, groundedness/relevance checks, failure-mode analysis, human review, observability, regression testing, and release criteria.
Strong understanding of responsible AI delivery considerations including privacy, security, sensitive data, transparency, human oversight, bias/quality, misuse, model limitations, and proportionate controls based on risk.
Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary technical teams, resolve competing technical perspectives, mentor practitioners, and communicate complex AI concepts and tradeoffs to senior non-technical stakeholders.
Recommended certification: Azure AI Engineer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS AI/ML or Solutions Architect credential, Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer, or comparable cloud/AI certification.
Ability to successfully complete and maintain all required federal background investigation, suitability, and Public Trust requirements associated with the position, and comply with applicable VA security, privacy, training, records, and data-handling requirements.

Desired Qualfications

12+ years of enterprise technology experience with 5+ years leading AI/ML, advanced analytics, intelligent automation, or emerging-technology delivery in complex or regulated environments.
Prior Department of Veterans Affairs, VHA, other federal health, federal civilian, or similarly complex regulated-enterprise technology experience.
Experience delivering production or pilot GenAI/agentic AI solutions integrated with enterprise data sources, APIs, workflow systems, retrieval services, identity/access controls, and user-facing applications.
Experience with modern AI engineering ecosystems such as Azure AI Foundry/Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Google Vertex AI, Databricks, LangChain/LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, or comparable platforms/frameworks.
Experience with AI observability, model/prompt/version management, automated evaluation, red teaming/adversarial testing, guardrails/content safety, or enterprise AI lifecycle management.
Experience establishing reusable AI standards, reference patterns, evaluation harnesses, or shared components; additional cloud, security, data, architecture, Agile, or program-management credentials are valued.

Target salary range: $145,000 - $220,000

Disclaimer: The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

added.description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

Job Description

Location

This is a remote role in the USA.

About The Job You're Considering

As a Resident Solutions Architect, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor and hands-on leader for enterprise data and analytics initiatives. You will partner with client stakeholders and delivery teams to design, optimize, and scale modern data platforms leveraging Databricks and cloud-native technologies. This role combines deep technical expertise with consulting and architecture leadership to drive successful business outcomes.

We are partnering with a well-established organization in the construction industry seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to help lead the architecture and continued evolution of its enterprise data, analytics, and AI ecosystem.

This is a highly visible technical leadership role for someone who can see the big picture while still understanding how modern data platforms are designed and built. The ideal candidate brings deep experience across data engineering, architecture, analytics, cloud technologies, and AI/ML infrastructure and can translate business needs into scalable technical solutions. This role is on-site, based on Dallas, Texas.

Key Responsibilities

Design and own end-to-end solution architecture across the organization's data, analytics, and AI ecosystem.

added.title: Forward Deployment AI Engineer
added.description:
Fulltime Position

Location: New York (hybrid 2-3 days a week in the office)

Travel: 20-25% (mostly US only but some International)

Our client is looking to add a Forward Deployment Engineer to their team in New York. The team is small and runs its own P&L, so there's no separate strategist, product manager, or support desk. You'll cover product, integration and operations, and you'll spend much of your time inside our operating companies. You'll learn how their teams work, connect the platform to their systems, change day-to-day workflows, and prove the impact in dollars. What you learn in the field shapes the product.

What you'll own
• Discovery: map how each business works, find the opportunities with the highest return, and flag local solutions worth turning into shared capabilities
• Deployments, end to end onboard new operating companies, integrate with their tools, and get front-line teams using the platform every day
• The product: build features across the stack, close integration gaps, and fix what breaks
• Agentic workflows: design agents with tool use, memory and multi-agent orchestration for triage, enrichment, root cause analysis and proactive support
• Earning trust, be the technical advisor each customer's leaders and front-line staff rely on, translate AI into business value, and earn the operational changes the platform depends on
• Enablement: train local AI leads and front-line teams to own and improve what you deploy, so you can move on to the next one
• Reporting results: set baselines, measure impact and cost, and report to leadership on what's working and what isn't
• The playbook: document each deployment so the next one takes less time

What you'll need
• A strong track record of shipping software that real users depend on, and owning it after launch
• Full-stack fluency in TypeScript/Node and React, or a strong background in another language (Python, Java, C#, Go) and the appetite to switch. We care more about how fast you learn than about whether you've used our exact tools.
• Integration experience with third-party APIs: auth flows, rate limits, webhooks and messy data
• Production experience with LLMs from one or more major providers: tool-using agents, evaluation, cost control, and prompt-injection defense
• Cloud deployment on AWS or another major provider: containers, managed databases, secrets, CI/CD and infrastructure as code

Preferred
• Experience in IT services or managed service operations
• Relational database depth: schema design, migrations, query tuning, and tenant isolation in the data layer
• Agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar), and the judgment to know when AI-written code is safe to merge
• Multi-tenancy, access control, and audit trails
• MCP servers and modern agent frameworks
• Security and privacy work: data residency, PII handling and SOC 2-style controls

Who thrives here
• You own a number, not just a feature. You set a baseline, measure the impact, and kill what doesn't pay.
• You treat cost as a product input. Model spend; compute and per-customer margin are part of your design decisions.
• You'd rather build once for many businesses than build bespoke for one.
• You find messy problems energizing. Integrations break, data is messy, and the customer's real process rarely matches the documentation.
• You're comfortable with ambiguity and a small team, and you'd rather spend a day being scrappy than writing a spec.

updated.title: Software Engineer, ML Performance
updated.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

Join us at NVIDIA and be part of a team that’s crafting the future of technology! Our dedication to innovation and excellence has made us a leader in computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for over 25 years. As we delve into the limitless opportunities that AI brings, we are looking for passionate individuals to help us push boundaries and redefine what's possible. NVIDIA is seeking a dedicated Software Engineer, ML Performance to join our team in Santa Clara, CA. In this role, you will engage directly with the latest AI technologies and work on optimizing performance at an outstanding scale. Your expertise will ensure that our groundbreaking solutions operate flawlessly and continue to lead the industry.

What You’ll Be Doing

Analyze the performance of distributed training and inference workloads throughout the entire stack: model and framework, data loading and checkpointing, compiler and kernels, CUDA and NCCL, host and network. Identify the bottleneck, resolve it or suggest a solution, and provide the supporting evidence.
Define the performance metrics tracked across a fleet of GPUs. Break them down into factors engineers need to debug. Decide which signals the platform collects first.
Drive the analysis of regressions: segment workloads across machines, versions, and configurations to isolate the cause, and turn the method into analysis others can reuse.
Evaluate automated diagnoses: judge whether a finding is accurate, identify misleading results and missed problems, and build the labeled cases that keep the analysis honest.
Work closely with build partners on their real workloads, carry findings through to improvements, and feed what the product is missing back into the roadmap.

What We Need To See

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
12+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including hands-on optimization of GPU training or inference workloads in production.
Demonstrated performance work across more than one layer of the stack, with a clear account of the baseline, evidence, alternative explanations and validated outcome.
Experience diagnosing performance across many jobs, machines or tenants, not only tuning a single workload.
Enough familiarity with framework, runtime and compiler interfaces to say where a signal should be measured, even when someone else writes the instrumentation.
Ability to distinguish symptoms from causes, recognize noisy or incomplete measurements and the effects of the measurement itself, and know when the evidence is insufficient.
Strong programming and debugging skills, demonstrated by maintainable analysis code, tests or repeatable investigation procedures, including when using automated development tools.
Clear communication of findings, trade-offs and remaining uncertainty to the people who own the workload.
Proficiency with Python and CUDA.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Improved operation of both training and inference.
Deep knowledge of one or more of PyTorch, JAX, Megatron, NCCL, TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, SGLang or Dynamo.
Experience moving between application, system software, driver or hardware roles, and the full-stack view that comes with it.
Statistical judgment applied to noisy, multi-node fleet-scale performance data. Ideally, experience with counter-factual analysis and segmentation of workloads for diagnosing regressions.
Built debugging or performance-analysis tools used by other engineers, with evidence that they made investigations more effective.

#FleetGPUProfiling

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Job Description

We’re looking for a  Lead, AI Engineering & SDLC Automation
 to join our Developer Experience team and provide technical leadership for Productivity Solutions Division’s (PSD) AI engineering and SDLC automation efforts. This Expert individual contributor role will focus on using AI and automation to improve how our teams build, test, secure, and deliver software.

As part of Platform Engineering, you’ll help improve the development experience across PSD by bringing new capabilities and automation into the tools, platforms, and workflows our development community uses every day. This is a hands-on role that will help shape technical direction, evaluate new technologies, build solutions, and help teams adopt new tools and ways of working.

Impact

Your work will help PSD reduce manual effort, improve developer experience, and make software delivery more consistent and efficient. Success means turning AI capabilities into practical solutions that teams use and that measurably improve how software is developed and delivered.

What You’ll Do

Provide technical leadership for AI engineering and SDLC automation across PSD.
Shape the technical strategy, roadmap, and delivery approach for AI and automation in software engineering.
Identify, evaluate, and recommend tools, agents, copilots, platforms, and automation opportunities.
Design and deliver engineering tools, agentic workflows, copilots, and automation that improve developer productivity and software delivery.
Integrate these capabilities into continuous integration and delivery pipelines, developer paved roads, engineering workflows, and platform services.
Establish practical standards, governance practices, evaluation methods, safety guardrails, and secure integration patterns for responsible use of AI.
Partner with DevSecOps, Security, Quality Engineering, IT, platform teams, and engineering teams to bring automation into software delivery practices.
Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from discovery and experimentation through implementation, adoption, and measurement.
Build reference implementations and working examples that make it easier for teams to adopt new capabilities.
Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers and teams adopting new development practices.
Define and track measures of success, including adoption, developer productivity, toil reduction, quality, reliability, and developer experience.
Represent PSD in technical forums and contribute technical expertise to broader AI engineering and automation efforts across Agilent.

Qualifications

What You Bring

Typically 8+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, developer productivity, workflow automation, SDLC automation, or related areas.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Strong software engineering experience, including building integrations, automation, APIs, developer tooling, or platform capabilities.
Hands-on experience building or integrating AI agents, copilots, LLM-based solutions, agentic workflows, or similar capabilities.
Experience with continuous integration and delivery, SDLC tooling, developer workflows, and cloud or platform services.
Ability to take broad or ambiguous engineering problems and turn them into practical technical solutions.
Understanding of responsible AI practices, including governance, safety guardrails, evaluation methods, usage controls, and secure integration.
Experience leading technical work across teams through expertise, collaboration, and influence.
Experience helping engineering teams adopt new tools, technologies, and development practices.
Ability to balance developer productivity with quality, reliability, security, cost, and responsible AI use.
Ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly with engineers, technical leaders, and senior stakeholders.
Experience solving difficult engineering problems, sharing knowledge, and making an impact beyond a single team or project.
